> **Status (2026-10-19):** SGLang now runs DeepSeek-V4.1 monokernels through the sgl-amd-mono plugin (`--monokernel-backend amd`, #44353, merged 2026-10-15). This draft stays open as the record of our in-tree work and is not for merge. The parts the plugin does not have yet are proposed to sgl-amd-mono: <PR links>.


## Motivation

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash decode on MI355X runs many small kernels and two TP all-reduces in every layer. A monokernel runs a large part of a decoder layer, including its all-reduce, in one persistent launch, so a decode step needs far fewer launches.

This PR moves the two DeepSeek-V4.1 monokernel launches (FFN and K1) onto the plugin layout and API of RFC #43949, behind one switch: `--enable-monokernel`. The switch replaces the env vars `SGLANG_ROCM_MONO_DECODE` and `SGLANG_ROCM_MONO_K1`. The PR is based on main `d4daf52369` and does not depend on #44405-#44408. #44033 (K1 on all layers, and K2) stacks on this PR and is moving to the same plugin.

## Modifications

- New package `python/sglang/experimental/monokernels/` (35 files, RFC layout), plus the `experimental` package marker:
  - `guards.py`, `runtime.py`, `spec.py`: startup refusal, load hooks, staged attach, routing, spans, numerics and the spec registry.
  - `hip/common/`: the shared HIP runtime. Every wait between workgroups or GPUs goes through one guarded wait.
  - `hip/deepseek_v41/`: the DeepSeek-V4.1 spec and its gfx950 kernels, moved with `git mv` from `srt/models/deepseek_common/amd/dsv41_mono/`.
- Two spans per layer. SGLang's attention core runs between them, because its state lives in the attention backend (RFC section 5).
  - `k1` (`layer_in` -> `core_in`): the pending mHC post, the mHC pre, the norm, and the attention front (wqkv_a, q and kv norms, wq_b, RoPE, SWA KV write). It runs on 30 layers in decode: the layers without a compressor or indexer, except layer 0 and the Engram layers. DSpark captures the input of three of them, so a verify step runs `k1` on 27 layers.
  - `ffn` (`attn_partial` -> `layer_out`): the attention all-reduce, the FFN seam, the MoE with the shared expert, and the MoE all-reduce. All 40 layers.
- Decode and DSpark verify graphs of up to 48 rows use the monokernels (up to 48 decode requests, or 8 requests in a verify step). Larger graphs use the normal path.
- Safety (RFC sections 7-9):
  - Startup refuses every unsupported setting and lists all reasons at once (for example DP attention, EP, PP, LoRA, eager or breakable decode graphs, a GPU other than gfx950, TP other than 2 or 4).
  - Every wait has a deadline: half of `--watchdog-timeout`, at most 60 s; a deadline below 5 s is refused. A timeout stops every rank, and no token of the failed step is sent.
  - All ranks agree at each attach stage. All buffers are allocated at attach, none during graph capture or replay.
- SGLang integration: 7 `srt` files, +75/-4: the flag, the config hook, three test env vars, and the load, attach, route and kernel calls in the DeepSeek-V4 model. Plus one CODEOWNERS line. With the switch off, SGLang runs its normal path.
- Tests: CPU unit tests (`test/registered/monokernels/unit`), kernel and fail-stop tests (`kernels`, nightly MI35x), serving tests (`e2e`, nightly MI35x), and `test/manual/monokernels/validate.py`.
- Usage: add `--enable-monokernel` to the DeepSeek-V4.1 MI355X recipe (cookbook section 3.6). Details: `python/sglang/experimental/monokernels/README.md`.
- Credits: `hip/SOURCE.md` lists the code adapted from [ROCm/ATOM](https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM/commit/97359d6df46c59736468168b7be8bc50b482a1a9) (MIT) and vLLM (Apache-2.0), with their licenses. No code is taken from #44406 or #44407.
- Review: the RFC migration is the last six commits, from `32e567e667`. `863fc1caff` and `0b265fdac8` are pure renames. The earlier commits are the first version of this PR and merges of main.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X, TP4, image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261009`, the cookbook section 3.6 recipe (DSpark block 5, Engram host table `per_rank`, `--enforce-shared-experts-fusion`, `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`), run with `validate.py`. Requests are sent 8 at a time, so every verify step runs on the monokernels.

End to end, switch on against switch off:

| Check | Switch on | Switch off |
|---|---|---|
| GSM8K, 500 questions | 0.898 | 0.890 |
| NIAH, 64k and 128k tokens, 3 depths each | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| KL of decode logprobs | 0.0174 (on vs off) | 0.0123 (switch off, batch 8 vs batch 4) |
| DSpark accept length, 8 requests | 3.32 | 3.39 |

- Pass rules: GSM8K within 1 point of switch off; KL at most twice the switch-off noise plus 0.001 (0.0256); accept length at most 3 % lower (here 2.3 %, from 26 and 25 log lines).
- A separate decode-only run (no DSpark, no host table) scored 0.915 on 200 GSM8K questions with the switch on. It also checked the 48-row limit: 48-row steps ran on the monokernels and larger steps (56 and 64 rows) on the normal path, with the same answer.

GPU kernel and fail-stop tests:

| Test | TP2 | TP4 |
|---|---|---|
| FFN and K1 kernels against the test's reference, 22 widths | Passed | Passed |
| Graph replay: FFN 500 replays with 0 mismatches; K1 bit for bit against eager | Passed | Passed |
| Memory allocated during graph capture and replay | 0 bytes | 0 bytes |
| Fail-stop: a wait stalled on purpose, at each site, in the first and the fourth launch | 2 of 2 (1 site) | 28 of 28 (all 14 sites) |
| Fail-stop while serving: a stall in the last layer | - | Passed |

- The 22 widths are the 15 that a server builds plus 7 odd sizes.
- In the serving fail-stop, the server stops, and all 64 tokens it sent match the answer without the fault.
- Reproduce: `python3 test/manual/monokernels/validate.py --model <path> --tp 4` runs every check above; `--steps` picks a subset.
- These runs used an earlier build of this branch. Its runtime code differs from this head only in the `ffn.residual` bound (2^-7, now 2^-6).
- Pending (we will update this description when they finish):
  - Set the `ffn` output bound against SGLang's normal path (RFC section 10). It is still set against the test's reference.
  - Merge current main, then rerun every check above on that head, with GSM8K on all 1,319 questions. #43607 moved the DeepSeek-V4 layer loop that our model seams use, so two files conflict now.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

AgentX agentic benchmark, MI355X, TP4, DSpark block 5, 60 minutes per point, on the 393-entry `semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126` trace set. Every setup uses image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm720-mi35x-20261009`, AITER [`perf/v41-indexer-bf16-logits` at `cc177350`](https://github.com/kkHuang-amd/aiter/commit/cc1773508ca296e5889ce89313b55c009a985a65), `--fp8-gemm-backend aiter` and `--disable-shared-experts-fusion`. All points were measured on the same node.

Each cell: total throughput per GPU (tokens/s), then 1 ÷ ITL p90 (tokens/s per user).

| Users | Base (main `d4daf52369`) | #44405-#44408 (`e4f3665be4`) | This PR + #44405 | This PR + #44033 + #44405 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4,686 / 248 | 5,928 / 351 | pending | pending |
| 4 | 6,900 / 170 | 8,446 / 301 | pending | pending |
| 8 | 13,453 / 172 | pending | pending | pending |
| 16 | pending | pending | pending | pending |

- Each point is one 60-minute run with no request errors.
- #44405 (no DSpark host sync per step) is not monokernel code. It is in every monokernel setup so they compare fairly, and their gains over base include its share.
- The pending points are queued. We will update the table as they finish.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

nodes.body:
A general comment: You have all the monokernel code in models/deepseek_common/amd/dsv41_mono/ - So in a vendor-specific directory under a model-specific directory. I expect we'll be seeing a lot of monokernels for AMD devices, and they will probably be based on the same flysDSL skeleton. Are there reusable parts of the code that could be placed in some shared AMD monokernel library directory? Or is the idea of monokernels that they are self-sustainable when it comes to code?

Also, what is the maintainability when it comes to building optimally performning monokernels for gfx942, gfx950 and in the future also for gfx1250?

> A general comment: You have all the monokernel code in models/deepseek_common/amd/dsv41_mono/ - So in a vendor-specific directory under a model-specific directory. I expect we'll be seeing a lot of monokernels for AMD devices, and they will probably be based on the same flysDSL skeleton. Are there reusable parts of the code that could be placed in some shared AMD monokernel library directory? Or is the idea of monokernels that they are self-sustainable when it comes to code?
> 
> Also, what is the maintainability when it comes to building optimally performning monokernels for gfx942, gfx950 and in the future also for gfx1250?

Thanks @rkarhila-amd good questions!

On the code location: AMD maintainers have been careful with PRs that touch common code, so I kept this self-contained on purpose. Apart from some minor changes in `environ.py` and `deepseek_v4.py`, it's all new code under `deepseek_common/amd/` plus tests, and it's off by default. It's the same layout vLLM merged in vllm-project/vllm#60397. The reusable part is already split out in `dsv41_mono/common/` (from ROCm/ATOM's `atom/mono`). When a second model's mono kernels come to SGLang, we can move it to a shared AMD folder in a small follow-up PR. vLLM is starting to do the same.

On other GPUs: this PR is gfx950 only and stops at startup with a clear error elsewhere, so gfx942 users see no change. gfx942 is possible but needs a port, and vLLM has a draft for it (vllm-project/vllm#60731). With 64 KB of LDS instead of 160 KB, it takes up to 42 rows instead of 48, runs at TP4 only and adds a few kernels. We can bring it over as a follow-up PR. For gfx1250, I'd wait: these kernels are built for fixed shapes and tuned per chip, so a small separate PR once the hardware and FlyDSL support are ready is cleaner.

Update: SGLang now runs DeepSeek-V4.1 monokernels through the sgl-amd-mono plugin (`--monokernel-backend amd`, #44353). We compared this PR with the plugin's `deepseek_v41`, and sent the parts the plugin does not have yet to sgl-amd-mono:

- sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono#<N1>: the FFN seam builds its residual with SGLang's arithmetic, as the K1 seam already does. The residual now matches SGLang's bit for bit at all 48 widths, at TP2 and TP4, with no measurable change in launch time.
- sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono#<N2>: the kernel checks test every width the spec builds. This check found the FFN seam deviation at TP4.
- sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono#<N3>: the graph checks fail on allocator growth during capture or replay.
- sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono#<N4>: a fault on one rank must stop every rank, tested with one process per rank.
- sgl-project/sgl-amd-mono#<N5>: the e2e fault test passes on ROCm 7.2 images, which report the fault without an address.

This draft stays open as the record of our in-tree work. It is not for merge.

@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Experimental SGLang features that live outside ``srt/``."""

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+# Monokernels (experimental)
+
+`--enable-monokernel` runs the decode and verify steps of a supported model on monokernels: persistent kernels
+that run most of a decoder layer, including its tensor-parallel all-reduce, in one or two launches. It is off by
+default. With it off, nothing changes. Design: RFC #43949.
+
+## Supported
+
+| Model | Devices | Parallelism | Steps |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | gfx950 (MI355X) | TP 2 or TP 4, one node | decode and DSpark verify steps up to 48 rows |
+
+## Startup refusal
+
+With the switch on, the server refuses to start, and lists every reason at once, when the deployment uses a
+feature the model's monokernels do not support. Refused for every model unless its spec lists the feature:
+pipeline parallelism, TP across nodes, data-parallel attention, expert parallelism and EPLB, context parallelism,
+decode context parallelism, speculative decoding (DeepSeek-V4.1 accepts DSpark), uneven verify steps, two-batch
+overlap, LoRA, PD disaggregation, hierarchical KV cache, memory saver, CPU offload and weight backup,
+torch-compiled decode, deterministic inference, RL on-policy mode, a decode CUDA graph that is eager
+(`--disable-decode-cuda-graph`, `--cuda-graph-backend-decode disabled`) or breakable (`--debug-cuda-graph`,
+`--cuda-graph-backend-decode breakable`), and returning routed experts, indexer top-k or hidden states. A spec that
+is not bitwise also refuses deterministic and RL on-policy modes (RFC section 10). A `--watchdog-timeout` below 10 s
+is refused (every wait has a deadline of half the watchdog, at most 60 s). Online weight updates are refused while
+the kernels are attached.
+
+## Tested recipe (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MI355X)
+
+The cookbook's agentic command (`docs/cookbook/autoregressive/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V4_1.mdx`, section 3.6), with
+`--enable-monokernel` added and nothing else changed: FP4 routed experts and the FP8 shared expert,
+`--fp8-gemm-backend aiter`, `--enforce-shared-experts-fusion`, DSpark with block size 5,
+`--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`, `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled`, `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64`,
+`--watchdog-timeout 3600`, and its environment, including the Engram host table
+(`SGLANG_ENABLE_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE=1`, `SGLANG_DSV41_ENGRAM_HOST_TABLE_LAYOUT=per_rank`). The cookbook's
+data-parallel-attention command (concurrency 32-64) is refused. "Tested" here means it has passed
+`test/manual/monokernels/validate.py` with this command, at the commit and GPU count stated in the pull request.
+
+## How a failed step stops (fail-stop)
+
+Every cross-workgroup and cross-GPU wait has a deadline of half the watchdog (at most 60 s). A wait that passes it
+records the reason and site in this rank's stop block, flags every peer, and ends its launch; a flagged peer ends
+its launch the same way. A rank finishes a step only once it has every peer's data for it, and every serving step
+ends with a TP collective (the logits gather) that a stopped rank never joins, so no token of a failed step is
+returned and SGLang stops the process tree (RFC section 8). There is no per-launch completion handshake.
+
+## Span naming
+
+The RFC names the per-span entry point `kernel(layer_id, point, key)`; this plugin's build object spells it
+`span(plan, layer_id, span)`, taking the step's plan instead of a free key. The hooks `route`, `kernel`, `attach`,
+`load_tensor` and `loaded` follow the RFC names.
+
+## Test hooks
+
+- `SGLANG_TEST_MONO_SPANS=<span>,<span>`: run only these spans (default: all). DeepSeek-V4.1's spans are `k1`
+  and `ffn`. An unknown name refuses startup.
+- `SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT=<rank>:<site>[:<after>]`: stall one named wait on one rank after `after` launches,
+  to test that the server stops on every rank and sends no token of the failed step. A bad rank or site refuses
+  startup.
+- `SGLANG_TEST_MONO_CHECK_NUMERICS=log|enforce`: at attach, measure each span against the normal path on the
+  loaded weights at every built width; `log` records the values, `enforce` refuses startup above the spec's bounds.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Startup refusal for ``--enable-monokernel``: every reason at once, before any weight loads (RFC #43949 section 7)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Any
+
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.spec import Feature, MonoSpec, load_spec
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import model_config_of, resolving_view
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+SWITCH = "--enable-monokernel"
+# every cross-workgroup or cross-GPU wait stops after half the watchdog timeout, at most 60 s; under 5 s refused
+MIN_DEADLINE_S = 5.0
+MAX_DEADLINE_S = 60.0
+
+SGLANG_READS = {
+    "srt/arg_groups/overrides.py": ("resolving_view", "model_config_of"),
+    "srt/environ.py": (
+        "envs",
+        "SGLANG_TEST_MONO_SPANS",
+        "SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT",
+        "SGLANG_TEST_MONO_CHECK_NUMERICS",
+    ),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/parallel.py": (
+        "tp_size",
+        "pp_size",
+        "nnodes",
+        "enable_dp_attention",
+        "ep_size",
+        "attn_cp_size",
+        "dcp_size",
+    ),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/exec_.py": (
+        "enable_monokernel",
+        "enable_eplb",
+        "enable_two_batch_overlap",
+        "enable_memory_saver",
+        "cpu_offload_gb",
+        "enable_weights_cpu_backup",
+        "enable_torch_compile",
+        "enable_deterministic_inference",
+        "rl_on_policy_target",
+        "disable_cuda_graph",
+        "cuda_graph_config",
+        "debug_cuda_graph",
+        "enable_return_routed_experts",
+        "enable_return_indexer_topk",
+        "enable_return_hidden_states",
+    ),
+    "srt/model_executor/cuda_graph_config.py": (
+        "decode",
+        "backend",
+        '"disabled"',
+        '"breakable"',
+    ),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/spec.py": (
+        "speculative_algorithm",
+        "speculative_eagle_topk",
+    ),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/lora.py": ("enable_lora", "lora_paths"),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/disagg.py": ("disaggregation_mode", '"null"'),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/memory.py": ("enable_hierarchical_cache",),
+    "srt/arg_groups/fields/device.py": ("watchdog_timeout",),
+}
+
+
+class MonoRefused(ValueError):
+    """The configuration or the loaded model is outside what the model's monokernels serve."""
+
+
+def _decode_graph(c) -> str:
+    """The resolved decode CUDA graph backend (``--disable-decode-cuda-graph`` and ``--cuda-graph-backend-decode``
+    fold into it)."""
+    return c.cuda_graph_config.decode.backend
+
+
+# feature -> whether the resolved configuration uses it; a probe that cannot read its setting counts as in use
+_PROBES: dict = {
+    Feature.PIPELINE_PARALLEL: lambda c: (c.pp_size or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.MULTI_NODE_TP: lambda c: (c.nnodes or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.DP_ATTENTION: lambda c: bool(c.enable_dp_attention),
+    Feature.EXPERT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (c.ep_size or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.EPLB: lambda c: bool(c.enable_eplb),
+    Feature.CONTEXT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (c.attn_cp_size or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.DECODE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL: lambda c: (c.dcp_size or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.SPECULATIVE: lambda c: c.speculative_algorithm is not None,
+    Feature.UNEVEN_VERIFY: lambda c: (c.speculative_eagle_topk or 1) > 1,
+    Feature.TWO_BATCH_OVERLAP: lambda c: bool(c.enable_two_batch_overlap),
+    Feature.LORA: lambda c: bool(c.enable_lora) or bool(c.lora_paths),
+    Feature.PD_DISAGGREGATION: lambda c: (c.disaggregation_mode or "null") != "null",
+    Feature.KV_OFFLOAD: lambda c: bool(c.enable_hierarchical_cache),
+    Feature.MEMORY_RELEASE: lambda c: bool(c.enable_memory_saver),
+    Feature.CPU_OFFLOAD: lambda c: (c.cpu_offload_gb or 0) > 0,
+    Feature.WEIGHT_BACKUP: lambda c: bool(c.enable_weights_cpu_backup),
+    Feature.TORCH_COMPILE: lambda c: bool(c.enable_torch_compile),
+    Feature.DETERMINISTIC: lambda c: bool(c.enable_deterministic_inference),
+    Feature.RL_ON_POLICY: lambda c: c.rl_on_policy_target is not None,
+    Feature.EAGER: lambda c: (
+        bool(c.disable_cuda_graph) or _decode_graph(c) == "disabled"
+    ),
+    Feature.BREAKABLE_DECODE_GRAPH: lambda c: (
+        bool(c.debug_cuda_graph) or _decode_graph(c) == "breakable"
+    ),
+    Feature.ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE: lambda c: bool(c.enable_return_routed_experts),
+    Feature.INDEXER_TOPK_CAPTURE: lambda c: bool(c.enable_return_indexer_topk),
+    Feature.HIDDEN_STATE_CAPTURE: lambda c: bool(c.enable_return_hidden_states),
+}
+
+
+def feature_reasons(cfg: Any, spec: MonoSpec, probes: dict = _PROBES) -> list:
+    reasons = []
+    for feature, probe in probes.items():
+        try:
+            used = probe(cfg)
+        except Exception as err:
+            used, why = True, f" (its setting cannot be read: {type(err).__name__})"
+        else:
+            why = ""
+        if used and feature not in spec.features:
+            reasons.append(f"{feature.value} is not supported{why}")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def deadline_s(watchdog_timeout) -> float:
+    """The deadline of every guarded wait: half the watchdog timeout, at most MAX_DEADLINE_S."""
+    if not watchdog_timeout or watchdog_timeout <= 0:
+        return MAX_DEADLINE_S
+    return min(float(watchdog_timeout) / 2, MAX_DEADLINE_S)
+
+
+def deadline_reasons(watchdog_timeout) -> list:
+    d = deadline_s(watchdog_timeout)
+    if d < MIN_DEADLINE_S:
+        return [
+            f"--watchdog-timeout {watchdog_timeout} gives a {d:g} s wait deadline; "
+            f"monokernels need at least {MIN_DEADLINE_S:g} s (a watchdog of {2 * MIN_DEADLINE_S:g} s)"
+        ]
+    return []
+
+
+def span_selection(spec: MonoSpec) -> tuple:
+    """The spans SGLANG_TEST_MONO_SPANS selects (default all) and the reasons for unknown names."""
+    raw = envs.SGLANG_TEST_MONO_SPANS.get() or ""
+    names = [n.strip() for n in raw.split(",") if n.strip()]
+    if not names:
+        return frozenset(spec.span_names), []
+    unknown = sorted(set(names) - set(spec.span_names))
+    if unknown:
+        return frozenset(), [
+            f"SGLANG_TEST_MONO_SPANS names {unknown}; {spec.name} has {list(spec.span_names)}"
+        ]
+    return frozenset(names), []
+
+
+def fault_injection(spec: MonoSpec, tp_size: int = 0) -> tuple:
+    """SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT=<rank>:<site>[:<after>] as (rank, site, after) or None, and the reasons
+    a set value is malformed: a rank outside the TP size, or a site the spec does not name."""
+    raw = envs.SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT.get() or ""
+    if not raw:
+        return None, []
+    want = f"SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT={raw!r}: want <rank>:<site>[:<after>]"
+    parts = raw.split(":")
+    if not (
+        len(parts) in (2, 3)
+        and parts[0].isdigit()
+        and parts[1]
+        and (len(parts) == 2 or parts[2].isdigit())
+    ):
+        return None, [want]
+    rank, site, after = int(parts[0]), parts[1], int(parts[2]) if len(parts) == 3 else 0
+    if tp_size and rank >= tp_size:
+        return None, [f"{want}, with a rank below the TP size {tp_size}"]
+    if spec.wait_sites and site not in spec.wait_sites:
+        return None, [f"{want}; {spec.name} has the wait sites {list(spec.wait_sites)}"]
+    return (rank, site, after), []
+
+
+def config_refusals(cfg: Any, hf_config: Any, spec: MonoSpec) -> list:
+    reasons = feature_reasons(cfg, spec)
+    reasons += deadline_reasons(cfg.watchdog_timeout)
+    reasons += span_selection(spec)[1]
+    reasons += fault_injection(spec, cfg.tp_size or 0)[1]
+    check = (envs.SGLANG_TEST_MONO_CHECK_NUMERICS.get() or "").strip()
+    if check not in ("", "log", "enforce"):
+        reasons.append(
+            f"SGLANG_TEST_MONO_CHECK_NUMERICS={check!r}: want log or enforce"
+        )
+    reasons += list(spec.config_disable_reasons(cfg, hf_config))
+    return reasons
+
+
+def raise_refused(spec_name: str, stage: str, reasons: list) -> None:
+    if reasons:
+        raise MonoRefused(
+            f"{SWITCH} ({spec_name}) refused at {stage}:\n  - " + "\n  - ".join(reasons)
+        )
+
+
+def handle_monokernel(server_args: Any) -> None:
+    """The config hook. With the switch on, refuse startup when the model has no spec or the resolved
+    deployment uses anything the spec does not support. Runs after every other resolution step."""
+    cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if not cfg.enable_monokernel:
+        return
+    hf_config = model_config_of(server_args).hf_config
+    arch = (getattr(hf_config, "architectures", None) or ["?"])[0]
+    spec = load_spec(arch)
+    if spec is None:
+        raise MonoRefused(f"{SWITCH}: no monokernel spec for {arch}")
+    raise_refused(spec.name, "startup", config_refusals(cfg, hf_config, spec))
+    logger.info(
+        "%s: the %s spec accepts this configuration; its kernels read %s",
+        SWITCH,
+        spec.name,
+        spec.requires,
+    )

+"""The launch epoch: every CTA marks it, and CTA 0 moves it on once all have."""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.kernels_common import kernel_signature
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    gstore,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.plan import BLOCKS
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.sync import _spin
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EPOCH_MARKS",
+    "epoch_begin",
+    "epoch_end",
+    "gstore",
+    "kernel_symbol",
+    "spin_until",
+]
+
+
+def kernel_symbol(stem, **params):
+    """Kernel symbol that profilers demangle to ``aiter::<stem>_<params>``."""
+    name = f"{stem}_{kernel_signature(**params)}"
+    return f"_ZN5aiter{len(name)}{name}E"
+
+
+def spin_until(load, pending, guard, site):
+    """``load()`` again (s_sleep between) while ``pending(value)``; the value. A guarded wait named ``site``."""
+    return _spin(load, pending, guard, site)
+
+
+EPOCH_MARKS = 4  # word offset of the per-CTA marks in the epoch buffer
+
+
+@traced
+def epoch_begin(c, epoch, ep):
+    """Mark that this CTA read epoch ``ep``."""
+    if c["tid"] == 0:
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            ep + 1, rsrc(epoch), EPOCH_MARKS + c["bid"], cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+        )
+
+
+@traced
+def epoch_end(c, epoch, ep, reset, guard):
+    """CTA 0: once every CTA marked the epoch (a guarded wait), run ``reset()`` unless None and move the epoch
+    on."""
+    if c["bid"] == 0:
+        tid = c["tid"]
+        if tid < BLOCKS:
+            r = rsrc(epoch)
+
+            def load_mark():
+                return fx.Int32(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        r,
+                        EPOCH_MARKS + tid,
+                        vec_width=1,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                    )
+                )
+
+            _ = spin_until(load_mark, lambda v: v != ep + 1, guard, "epoch")
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if tid == 0:
+            if const_expr(reset is not None):
+                reset()
+            gstore(epoch, ep + 1, words=1)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Host side of the guarded waits (RFC #43949 section 8).
+
+Every cross-workgroup or cross-GPU wait has a deadline. A wait that passes it records the reason and the site in
+this rank's stop block, flags every peer, and ends its launch with a store to address 0; a wait that sees a flag
+ends its launch the same way without writing a reason, so the first reason stays.
+
+Stop block, one per rank in peer memory: word STOP_REASON is this rank's deadline stop (reason | site << 8 |
+rank << 16); word STOP_FLAG is (peer rank + 1) | site << 8 of the peer whose deadline passed.
+
+Guard block, int32 words in device memory, found by the kernels through the epoch buffer (words EPOCH_GUARD and
+EPOCH_GUARD + 1 hold its address): G_DEADLINE (i64 clock ticks), G_OWN (i64 address of this rank's stop block),
+G_RANK, G_NPES, G_MIRROR (i64 address of words a test can read after the processes end, see MIRROR_*; 0 for none),
+and from G_PEERS the i64 address of every rank's stop block."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.peer_memory import PeerBuffer
+
+TICKS_PER_S = 100_000_000  # s_memrealtime runs at 100 MHz
+EPOCH_GUARD = 2
+STOP_REASON, STOP_FLAG = 0, 1
+STOP_BYTES = 64
+G_DEADLINE, G_OWN, G_RANK, G_NPES, G_MIRROR, G_PEERS = 0, 2, 4, 5, 6, 8
+MAX_PEERS = 8
+GUARD_WORDS = G_PEERS + 2 * MAX_PEERS
+REASON_DEADLINE, REASON_PEER = 1, 2
+# mirror words: the deadline reason, the reason of a stop after a peer's flag, and (fault-injection builds
+# only) the site of the wait the injected stall holds
+MIRROR_DEADLINE, MIRROR_PEER, MIRROR_ARMED = 0, 1, 2
+
+# wait-site names; a site's id is its index + 1. Kernel modules register their sites when imported, in a fixed
+# order, so an id names the same site in every process.
+_SITES: list = []
+
+
+def register_sites(names) -> None:
+    for name in names:
+        if name not in _SITES:
+            if len(_SITES) == 255:
+                raise ValueError("more than 255 named wait sites")
+            _SITES.append(name)
+
+
+def site_id(name: str) -> int:
+    if name not in _SITES:
+        raise ValueError(f"wait site {name!r} is not registered")
+    return _SITES.index(name) + 1
+
+
+def site_name(sid: int) -> str:
+    return _SITES[sid - 1] if 1 <= sid <= len(_SITES) else f"site {sid}"
+
+
+def sites() -> tuple:
+    """The registered wait sites."""
+    return tuple(_SITES)
+
+
+def decode_reason(word: int) -> dict:
+    """A STOP_REASON word as its reason, site and rank (None for 0)."""
+    if word == 0:
+        return {}
+    reason = {REASON_DEADLINE: "deadline", REASON_PEER: "peer stopped"}.get(
+        word & 0xFF, f"reason {word & 0xFF}"
+    )
+    return {"reason": reason, "site": site_name((word >> 8) & 0xFF), "rank": word >> 16}
+
+
+def decode_flag(word: int) -> dict:
+    """A STOP_FLAG word as the flagging peer and its site (None for 0)."""
+    if word == 0:
+        return {}
+    return {"peer": (word & 0xFF) - 1, "site": site_name((word >> 8) & 0xFF)}
+
+
+class Guard:
+    """One TP rank's guard: its stop block in peer memory and the guard block. The constructor is collective."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, tp: int, rank: int, group, device, deadline_s: float, mirror_ptr: int = 0
+    ):
+        if tp > MAX_PEERS:
+            raise ValueError(f"guarded waits support up to {MAX_PEERS} ranks, got {tp}")
+        self.deadline_s = deadline_s
+        self.stop = PeerBuffer(STOP_BYTES, group, rank, tp, device)
+        self.stop.bytes.zero_()
+        words = torch.zeros(GUARD_WORDS, dtype=torch.int32)
+        w64 = words.view(torch.int64)
+        w64[G_DEADLINE // 2] = int(deadline_s * TICKS_PER_S)
+        w64[G_OWN // 2] = self.stop.local
+        words[G_RANK], words[G_NPES] = rank, tp
+        w64[G_MIRROR // 2] = mirror_ptr
+        for p, addr in enumerate(self.stop.addresses.tolist()):
+            w64[G_PEERS // 2 + p] = addr
+        self.block = words.to(device)
+
+    def bind(self, epoch: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Point an epoch buffer at this guard block (before any launch, outside graph capture)."""
+        addr = torch.tensor([self.block.data_ptr()], dtype=torch.int64).view(
+            torch.int32
+        )
+        epoch[EPOCH_GUARD : EPOCH_GUARD + 2].copy_(addr.to(epoch.device))
+
+    def reason(self) -> dict:
+        """This rank's stop block as the host reads it."""
+        words = self.stop.bytes[:8].view(torch.int32).tolist()
+        return {
+            "own": decode_reason(words[STOP_REASON]),
+            "flag": decode_flag(words[STOP_FLAG]),
+        }
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self.stop.close()

+"""FP8 / MX arithmetic shared by the mono kernels."""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import rocdl

+FP8_MAX = 448.0
+# the f8f6f4 MFMA's operand formats (cbsz / blgp)
+FP8, FP4 = 0, 4
+UNIT_SCALE = 127  # the E8M0 code of 1.0

+
+def clamp_fp8(v):
+    """``v`` clamped to the E4M3 range."""
+    return fx.max(fx.min(v, fx.Float32(FP8_MAX)), fx.Float32(-FP8_MAX))
+
+
+def code_ceil(v):
+    """Return the biased exponent of the smallest power of two >= ``v``, clamped to [1, 254]."""
+    bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32)
+    e = ((bits >> 23) & 0xFF) + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).select(
+        fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)
+    )
+    return fx.max(fx.min(e, fx.Int32(254)), fx.Int32(1))

+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.dpp_utils import update_dpp_i32
+from flydsl._mlir import ir
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm

+CM_DEV = 16
+
+
+CM_SYS = 17
+
+

+def rsrc(addr, nbytes=None):
+    return bo.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(addr, num_records_bytes=nbytes)
+
+
+def _gptr(addr):
+    return llvm.IntToPtrOp(
+        ir.Type.parse("!llvm.ptr<1>"), as_ir_value(fx.Int64(addr))
+    ).result
+
+
+def claim_i32(buf, word, value):
+    """Device-scope (agent) compare-and-swap word ``word`` of global buffer address ``buf`` from 0 to ``value``;
+    the Boolean whether this call won the claim. Device scope is right here: only this GPU's workgroups write
+    this rank's stop reason, so the race for the word is among them, not across GPUs (peers only read the stop
+    flag). Orders the write before this launch's later stores."""
+    at = buf + fx.Int64(word * 4)
+    ptr = fx.inttoptr(fx.PointerType.get(T.i32, fx.AddressSpace.Global, 4), at)
+    _, won = fx.llvm.atomic_cas(
+        ptr,
+        fx.Int32(0),
+        fx.Int32(value),
+        syncscope="agent",
+        success_ordering=fx.AtomicOrdering.AcqRel,
+    )
+    return won
+
+
+def gstore(addr, value, words=4):
+    """Store ``words`` i32 (an Int32 or a Vector) at a 64-bit global address."""
+    v = as_ir_value(fx.Int32(value) if words == 1 else value)
+    llvm.StoreOp(v, _gptr(addr), alignment=4 * words)

+def memrealtime():
+    """The 100 MHz device clock (s_memrealtime)."""
+    return fx.Int64(llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], []))
+
+
+def permlane_swap(off, x, y):
+    """v_permlane{32,16}_swap on registers (x, y); returns (x', y')."""
+    swap = rocdl.permlane32_swap if off == 32 else rocdl.permlane16_swap
+    pr = swap(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(x)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(y)),
+        False,
+        False,
+    )

+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v, a source lane a lane (ds_bpermute)."""

+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x118, 0xF, 0xC, False))

+    elif off == 4:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x114, 0xF, 0xA, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x104, 0xF, 0x5, False))
+    elif off == 2:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x4E, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    else:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0xB1, 0xF, 0xF, False))

+    """op(v, lane ^ off) for a symmetric op; 32 / 16 take both halves of one swap."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return op(v, xshfl(v, off))
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, x, x)
+    if is_f:
+        return op(a.bitcast(fx.Float32), b.bitcast(fx.Float32))

+    return a + b

+def butterfly(v, offsets, op=_add):
+    """Butterfly reduction over the xor offsets in the given order (the order sets the result bits)."""
+    for off in offsets:
+        v = xred(v, off, op)
+    return v

+def traced(fn):
+    """Apply FlyDSL's AST rewrite to a helper, so its control flow on traced values lowers to scf."""
+    return ASTRewriter.transform(fn)

+@traced
+def batched_rounds(tid, n, load, use, batch=LOAD_BATCH):
+    """Strided CTA loop over v < n: ``batch`` rounds of ``load(v)`` issued before each ``use``."""
+    rounds = -(-n // THREADS)
+    for b0 in range_constexpr(0, rounds, batch):
+        idx = range(b0, min(b0 + batch, rounds))

+def mfma_bf16(a, b, c):
+    return fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, c]))
+
+
+def row_sum(red, r, t, waves=None):
+    """Return row r, token t of the waves' MFMA accumulators, summed in wave order."""
+    tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in waves if waves is not None else range(WAVES):
+        tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + ((w * 64 + 16 * (r // 4) + t) * 4 + r % 4))
+    return tot

+
+def ballot(pred):
+    """The wave's lanes where ``pred`` holds, a bit a lane."""
+    return fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, as_ir_value(pred)))
+
+
+def popcount(x):
+    return fx.Int32(fx.ctpop(x))
+
+
+def lanes_below(bal, lane):
+    """How many of the lanes in ballot ``bal`` are below ``lane``."""
+    return popcount(bal & ((fx.Int64(1) << fx.Int64(lane)) - 1))
+
+
+def load_ptr64(table, i):
+    """Load entry ``i`` of an i64 table, wave-uniform."""
+    pw = fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(table), i * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32))
+    return (fx.Int64(uniform(pw[1])) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(uniform(pw[0])))
+
+
+def bf16_round(a):
+    return fx.Float32(fx.Float32(a).to(fx.BFloat16))
+
+
+def bf16_pair(a, b):
+    """Two f32 -> one f32-typed word holding (bf16(a), bf16(b))."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([a, b], fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Float32)[0]
+    )
+
+
+def bf_lo(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's low half."""
+    return (w << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf_hi(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's high half."""
+    return (w & fx.Int32(-65536)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf2_f32(w):
+    """Packed bf16 pair word -> (f32 low, f32 high)."""
+    return bf_lo(w), bf_hi(w)
+
+
+def fp8_pack4(a, b, c, d):
+    """Four f32 (already in range) -> one dword of four E4M3 bytes, RNE."""
+    lo = fx.Int32(rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, a, b, fx.Int32(0), False))
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.cvt_pk_fp8_f32(T.i32, c, d, lo, True))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- TP ranks
+def peer_bases(peers, tp):
+    """Load every rank's peer buffer base from the ``peers`` table once."""
+    return [load_ptr64(peers, p) for p in range(tp)]
+
+
+def sum_partials(poll, own, pair_of, tp):
+    """Poll the ``tp`` ranks' bf16 pair partials and sum them in fp32 in rank order."""
+    ws = poll([(own, pair_of(src), 1) for src in range(tp)])
+    acc0, acc1 = bf2_f32(ws[0][0])
+    for src in range_constexpr(1, tp):
+        lo, hi = bf2_f32(ws[src][0])
+        acc0 = acc0 + lo
+        acc1 = acc1 + hi
+    return acc0, acc1

+"""Symmetric peer memory for the in-kernel TP all-reduces."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.quick_allreduce_int4_ipc import UncachedIpcHeap
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- TP agreement
+class MonoUnsupported(Exception):
+    """The loaded model or runtime configuration is outside what mono serves."""
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool, group) -> bool:
+    """Return True when every rank of ``group`` passed ``ok`` true (collective)."""
+    if group is None:
+        return ok
+    flag = torch.tensor([int(ok)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    dist.all_reduce(flag, op=dist.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group)
+    return bool(flag.item())
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- peer buffers
+class _DeviceBytes:
+    """Return a ``__cuda_array_interface__`` of ``nbytes`` at a raw device address."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ptr: int, nbytes: int):
+        self.__cuda_array_interface__ = {
+            "shape": (nbytes,),
+            "typestr": "|u1",
+            "data": (ptr, False),
+            "version": 3,
+        }
+
+
+class PeerBuffer:
+    """One uncached buffer per rank with every peer's address; the constructor is collective."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        nbytes: int,
+        group,
+        rank: int,
+        npes: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        self.local = UncachedIpcHeap.alloc_uncached(nbytes)
+        # a view, not an owner: close() frees the memory under it
+        self.bytes = torch.as_tensor(_DeviceBytes(self.local, nbytes), device=device)
+        self.rank = rank
+        self._opened: list[int] = []
+        addresses = [self.local]
+        if npes > 1:
+            handles = UncachedIpcHeap.gather_object_list_via_broadcast(
+                group, UncachedIpcHeap.get_mem_handle_bytes(self.local)
+            )
+            addresses, failure = [], None
+            try:
+                for peer, handle in enumerate(handles):
+                    if peer == rank:
+                        addresses.append(self.local)
+                    else:
+                        base = UncachedIpcHeap.open_mem_handle(handle)
+                        self._opened.append(base)
+                        addresses.append(base)
+            except RuntimeError as err:  # every rank must still reach the agreement
+                failure = err
+            if not tp_agree(failure is None, group):
+                self.close()
+                raise MonoUnsupported(
+                    "peer memory handshake failed on "
+                    f"{'this' if failure else 'another'}"
+                    " TP rank"
+                ) from failure
+        self.addresses = torch.tensor(addresses, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        """Close the peer mappings and free the local buffer (idempotent)."""
+        opened, self._opened = self._opened, []
+        for base in opened:
+            UncachedIpcHeap.close_mem_handle(base)
+        if self.local:
+            self.bytes = None
+            UncachedIpcHeap.free_device_mem(self.local)
+            self.local = 0

+    return (bid - base % BLOCKS + BLOCKS) % BLOCKS

+PAIR_BYTES = 8  # a (value, tag) pair
+

+def pair_layout(items, align: int = PAIR_BYTES, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """Lay out ``items`` (name, pairs) in order: name -> (byte offset, bytes), ``align``-aligned."""
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = (off + align - 1) // align * align
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR_BYTES)
+        off += pairs * PAIR_BYTES
+    return out
+

+def sel(pred, a, b):
+    """Return a if pred else b, as ``select`` on traced values."""
+    if isinstance(pred, bool):
+        return a if pred else b
+    out = pred.select(a, b)
+    traced = [x for x in (a, b) if not isinstance(x, int)]
+    return type(traced[0])(out) if traced else out

+    return sel(a < b, a, b)

+    if isinstance(x, int):

+    return x

+    return i32((a + b - 1) // b)

+

+@dataclass(frozen=True)

+    tp: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.tp < 1:
+            raise ShardError(f"TP {self.tp}")
+
+    def split(self, full: int, what: str) -> int:
+        """``full`` / tp, refusing a remainder: a rank's share of ``what``."""
+        if full % self.tp:
+            raise ShardError(f"{what} {full} is not divisible by TP {self.tp}")
+        return full // self.tp
+

+def padded(n: int, align: int) -> int:
+    return cdiv(n, align) * align

+

+@functools.cache
+def source_digest(*paths: str) -> str:
+    """Return the sha256 of every ``.py`` file under ``paths`` (path and contents)."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    for rel in paths:
+        root = _ROOT / rel
+        files = [root] if root.is_file() else sorted(root.rglob("*.py"))
+        if not files:
+            raise FileNotFoundError(f"no kernel sources at {root}")
+        for f in files:
+            h.update(str(f.relative_to(_ROOT)).encode())

+                " a scalar to reach the JIT cache key"
+            )
+        out.append((f.name, value))
+    out.append(("sources", sources))
+    return tuple(out)

+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(own), STOP_FLAG, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_SYS
+            )
+        )
+        late = (now - t0) > load_ptr64(block, G_DEADLINE // 2)
+        if const_expr(self.stalls(site) is not None):
+            mirror = load_ptr64(block, G_MIRROR // 2)
+            if self.stalls(site) & (mirror != 0):
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Int32(site_id(site)),
+                    rsrc(mirror),
+                    MIRROR_ARMED,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        if late | (flagged != 0):
+            self.stop(site, late, block, own)
+        return t0
+
+    @traced
+    def stop(self, site, late, block, own):
+        """End the launch with a store to address 0. A wait past its own deadline claims this rank's stop reason
+        with a compare-and-swap from 0 (so the first deadline is the one recorded, even when several workgroups
+        expire together), waits for that store, then flags every peer; a wait that saw a flag only stops."""
+        rank = fx.Int32(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(block), G_RANK, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+            )
+        )
+        sid = fx.Int32(site_id(site) << 8)
+        mirror = load_ptr64(block, G_MIRROR // 2)
+        if late:
+            why = fx.Int32(REASON_DEADLINE) | sid | (rank << 16)
+            won = claim_i32(own, STOP_REASON, why)
+            # the claim must land before the peer flags, so a peer reads a recorded reason here
+            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+            flag = (rank + 1) | sid
+            for p in range_constexpr(self.npes):
+                peer = load_ptr64(block, G_PEERS // 2 + p)
+                bo.buffer_store(flag, rsrc(peer), STOP_FLAG, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+            if (mirror != 0) & won:
+                # only the winning workgroup records the mirror reason, so the test reads the first deadline too;
+                # `&`, not `and`: `and` would call bool() on a traced value at trace time
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    why, rsrc(mirror), MIRROR_DEADLINE, cache_modifier=CM_SYS
+                )
+        else:
+            if mirror != 0:
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Int32(REASON_PEER) | sid | (rank << 16),
+                    rsrc(mirror),
+                    MIRROR_PEER,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+        gstore(fx.Int64(0), rank, words=1)
+
+
+def _waiting(pending, stall):
+    """The wait's loop condition: ``pending``, and at an armed fault site also the injected stall."""
+    if stall is None:
+        return pending
+    return lambda v: pending(v) | stall
+
+
+def _checker(guard, site):
+    return lambda t0: guard.check(site, t0)
+
+
+@traced
+def _spin(load_all, pending, guard, site):
+    """Re-issue ``load_all`` until ``pending`` clears. Every GUARD_POLLS polls the guard looks at the clock and
+    the stop word: past the deadline, or once a peer stopped, the launch stops."""
+    if guard is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"wait {site!r} without a guard: every wait needs a deadline")
+    v = load_all()
+    # the loop carries only traced values and callables
+    waiting = _waiting(pending, guard.stalls(site))
+    check = _checker(guard, site)
+    busy = waiting(v)
+    n = fx.Int32(0)
+    t0 = fx.Int64(0)
+    while busy:
+        rocdl.s_sleep(1)
+        v = load_all()
+        n = n + 1
+        if (n & (GUARD_POLLS - 1)) == 0:
+            t0 = check(t0)
+        busy = waiting(v)
+    return v
+
+
+class Space(Enum):
+    SCRATCH = "scratch"  # this GPU's memory: device-scope hand-off between CTAs
+    PEER = "peer"  # a peer-symmetric region: system-scope hand-off between GPUs
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Addr:
+    """A mailbox region's name, space and traced address; the space sets the scope."""
+
+    region: str
+    space: Space
+    value: object
+
+
+def sreg(base, offset, region):
+    """Scratch region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.SCRATCH, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def preg(base, offset, region):
+    """Return the address of peer-symmetric region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of buffer ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.PEER, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+# the store / load cache policy of a hand-off in each space
+_SCOPE_CM = {Space.SCRATCH: CM_DEV, Space.PEER: CM_SYS}
+
+
+class Mailbox:
+    """Tagged-pair hand-off between CTAs or GPUs: each value is stored next to the launch tag. A poll is a
+    guarded wait named after its first region."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tag, guard):
+        self.tag = tag
+        self.guard = guard
+
+    def put(self, a, i, v):
+        bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([bits, self.tag], fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_bf(self, a, i, vs):
+        """Store elements i .. i + len(vs) as packed bf16 pairs in one store."""
+        words = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(len(vs) // 2):
+            words += [bf16_pair(vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_words(self, a, i, words):
+        """Store raw 32-bit words at pairs i..; integer payloads must use this path."""
+        vals = []
+        for w in words:
+            vals += [fx.Int32(w), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def poll(self, specs, batch=POLL_MAX):
+        """Poll the pairs in ``specs`` (one space) until every tag is current; return the value words."""
+        if const_expr(len(specs) == 0):
+            return []
+        if const_expr(len(specs) > batch):
+            return self.poll(specs[:batch], batch) + self.poll(specs[batch:], batch)
+        spaces = {a.space for a, _, _ in specs}
+        if len(spaces) != 1:
+            raise ValueError(f"one poll batch spans {spaces}")
+        cm = _SCOPE_CM[spaces.pop()]
+        bases = [a.value for a, _, _ in specs]
+        tag = self.tag
+
+        def load_all():
+            words = []
+            for b, (_, i, n) in zip(bases, specs):
+                w = fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(b),
+                        fx.Int32(i) * 2,
+                        vec_width=2 * n,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=cm,
+                    )
+                )
+                words += [w[e] for e in range(2 * n)]
+            return fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+
+        nw = sum(2 * n for _, _, n in specs)
+
+        def pending(v):
+            bad = v[1] != tag
+            for e in range_constexpr(3, nw, 2):
+                bad = bad | (v[e] != tag)
+            return bad
+
+        v = _spin(load_all, pending, self.guard, specs[0][0].region)
+        outs, e = [], 0
+        for _, _, n in specs:
+            outs.append([v[e + 2 * q] for q in range(n)])
+            e += 2 * n
+        return outs
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(put, a, i, v, who):
+    """Drain this CTA's plain stores, then store mailbox pair (``a``, i) := v from thread ``who``."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if who:
+        put(a, i, v)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Device primitives of K1's attention front, adapted from ATOM's mono decode framework."""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.ops import bf16_pair, rsrc
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.sync import _spin
+
+# The execution model: one CTA a CU of an MI355X, all resident.
+BLOCKS = 256
+THREADS = 512
+WAVES = THREADS // 64
+
+# gfx95x cache policy bits: SC0 = 1, SC1 = 16 (device scope), NT = 2 (read once)
+CM_DEV = 16
+
+FP8_MAX = 448.0
+FP8, FP4 = 0, 4  # f8f6f4 MFMA operand formats
+FLT_MIN = 1.1754943508222875e-38
+
+POLL_MAX = 12  # mailbox pairs polled a batch
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- memory
+
+
+def ld_i32(ptr, i, cm=0):
+    return fx.Int32(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=cm)
+    )
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- math
+
+
+def tile_map(tid, width):
+    """Return (tid // width, tid % width) without a division."""
+    if width & (width - 1) == 0:
+        sh = width.bit_length() - 1
+        return tid >> sh, tid & (width - 1)
+    m = -(-(1 << 20) // width)
+    assert all((t * m) >> 20 == t // width for t in range(THREADS)), width
+    row = (tid * m) >> 20
+    return row, tid - row * width
+
+
+def fma(a, b, c):
+    return fx.Float32(fmath.fma(fx.Float32(a), fx.Float32(b), fx.Float32(c)))
+
+
+def div_rn(x, d, r):
+    """``x / d`` rounded to nearest (IEEE), given ``r = RN(1 / d)``."""
+    q = x * r
+    return fma(fma(-q, d, x), r, q)
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- packing
+
+
+def ceil_exp(v):
+    """Biased exponent of the smallest power of two >= v (v > 0 finite, normal)."""
+    bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32)
+    return ((bits >> 23) & 0xFF) + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).select(
+        fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)
+    )
+
+
+def mx_code(amax):
+    """vLLM's ROCm MXFP8 scale code: clamp(ceil(log2(max(amax, FLT_MIN) / 448)) + 127, 0, 254)."""
+    a = fx.max(amax, fx.Float32(FLT_MIN))
+    q = div_rn(a, fx.Float32(FP8_MAX), fx.Float32(1.0 / FP8_MAX))
+    return fx.min(fx.max(ceil_exp(q), fx.Int32(0)), fx.Int32(254))
+
+
+def mx_mul(code):
+    """2^(127 - code) as fp32, for code in [0, 254] (the quant multiplier)."""
+    return ((254 - code) << 23).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- MFMA
+
+
+def mfma_scaled(a, b, c, sa, sb, a_fmt=FP8, b_fmt=FP8):
+    """One 16x16x128 scaled MFMA (gfx950 f8f6f4) on hand-laid operands."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4(
+            T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, c, a_fmt, b_fmt, 0, sa, 0, sb]
+        )
+    )
+
+
+# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- mailbox
+
+
+class Mailbox:
+    """Poll tagged CTA hand-offs; the caller supplies the launch tag and the launch's wait guard."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tag, guard):
+        self.tag = tag
+        self.guard = guard
+
+    def put(self, base, i, v):
+        bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([bits, self.tag], fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(base),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+        )
+
+    def put_bf(self, base, i, vs):
+        """Elements i .. i + len(vs) (2 or 4, i aligned) as bf16 pairs, one store."""
+        words = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(len(vs) // 2):
+            words += [bf16_pair(vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(base),
+            i,
+            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+        )
+
+    def put_words(self, base, i, words):
+        """Raw 32-bit words (1 or 2) at pairs i.. (fp8 words must come this way)."""
+        vals = []
+        for w in words:
+            vals += [fx.Int32(w), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(base),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+        )
+
+    def poll(self, specs, site, batch=POLL_MAX):
+        """Poll the pairs in ``specs`` until every tag is current (a guarded wait named ``site``); return the
+        value words."""
+        if const_expr(len(specs) == 0):
+            return []
+        if const_expr(len(specs) > batch):
+            return self.poll(specs[:batch], site, batch) + self.poll(
+                specs[batch:], site, batch
+            )
+        tag = self.tag
+
+        def load_all():
+            words = []
+            for b, i, n in specs:
+                w = fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(b),
+                        fx.Int32(i) * 2,
+                        vec_width=2 * n,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                    )
+                )
+                words += [w[e] for e in range(2 * n)]
+            return fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+
+        nw = sum(2 * n for _, _, n in specs)
+
+        def pending(v):
+            bad = v[1] != tag
+            for e in range_constexpr(3, nw, 2):
+                bad = bad | (v[e] != tag)
+            return bad
+
+        v = _spin(load_all, pending, self.guard, site)
+        outs, e = [], 0
+        for _, _, n in specs:
+            outs.append([v[e + 2 * q] for q in range(n)])
+            e += 2 * n
+        return outs

+"""Run wqkv_a, the q / kv norms, RoPE, the V4 KV store and wq_b (K1's attention front)."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.epoch import gstore
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.mx import clamp_fp8
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.ops import (
+    bf16_round,
+    butterfly,
+    fp8_pack4,
+    hw_rsq,
+    row_sum,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    xshfl,
+)
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.common.plan import first_task
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.stages.gemv import (
+    ld_f32,
+    lds_row,
+    plus,
+    tile_rows,
+    token_tiles,
+)
+
+from .device import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    CM_DEV,
+    Mailbox,
+    ceil_exp,
+    div_rn,
+    fma,
+    ld_i32,
+    mx_code,
+    mx_mul,
+)
+from .gemv import (
+    RED,
+    chain_loads,
+    chain_mfmas,
+    chain_slots,
+    chain_store,
+    chain_sum,
+    gemv_loads,
+    gemv_mfmas,
+    rows_loads,
+    rows_store,
+)
+from .plan import (
+    DATA,
+    EPS,
+    HALF,
+    HEAD_DIM,
+    HIDDEN,
+    KV_DIM,
+    NOPE,
+    Q_RANK,
+    QKV_ROWS,
+    ROPE,
+    ROWS,
+    WQKV_KPARTS,
+    WQKV_TASKS,
+    Dims,
+    front_scratch,
+    wqkv_order,
+)
+
+X_WORDS = HIDDEN // 4
+X_GROUPS = HIDDEN // 32
+QX_WORDS = Q_RANK // 4
+KSTEPS = HIDDEN // 128 // WQKV_KPARTS  # an X8 K half's 128-steps
+KWORDS = KSTEPS * 32
+KGROUPS = KSTEPS * 4
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FrontBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    tp: int
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(c, region, i):
+    """This CTA's stores visible device-wide, then the flag pair (region, i)."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if c["tid"] == 0:
+        c["mb"].put(region, i, fx.Int32(1))
+
+
+@traced
+def await_flags(c, region, n, index):
+    """Thread u < n polls flag ``index(u)``; then the CTA proceeds."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    if tid < n:
+        c["mb"].poll([(region, index(fx.min(tid, n - 1)), 1)], "front_flags")
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- wqkv_a
+
+
+def stage_wqkv(c, ops, slots, n, halves):
+    """Run the wqkv chains against a token tile of n rows."""
+    accs = chain_mfmas(c, c["xl"], c["xsl"], ops, n, HIDDEN // 128, slots, halves)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return accs
+
+
+@traced
+def wqkv_publish(c, task, accs, slots, order, t0, n, live):
+    """Sum wqkv rows 16 task .. for tokens t0 .. t0 + n in SGLang's order into fp32 QKVP."""
+    tid, red = c["tid"], c["red"]
+    chain_store(c, red, accs, slots)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if (tid < ROWS * n) & live:
+        r = tid % ROWS
+        tl = tid // ROWS
+        t = plus(t0, tl)
+        v = chain_sum(red, r, tl, order)
+        c["mb"].put(c["qkvp"], t * QKV_ROWS + task * ROWS + r, v)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- q / kv norms
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_qkv(c, t):
+    """Token t: q_norm to QX8, and kv_norm + RoPE to the fp8_ds_mla record at its slot."""
+    tid, lane, wave, red = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["red"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    tt = fx.min(tid, 255)
+    mine = tid < 256
+    qc = [fx.min(tt * 8 + j, Q_RANK - 1) for j in range(8)]
+    # independent loads first: they overlap the partials' wait
+    qw = [c["ldbf"](a["qn_w"], qc[j]) for j in range(8)]
+    kw = [c["ldbf"](a["kvn_w"], tt * 2 + j) for j in range(2)]
+    pos = ld_i32(a["pos"], 2 * t)
+    slot = ld_i32(a["slot"], 2 * t)
+    jr = tt - NOPE // 2
+    is_rope = jr >= 0
+    jj = fx.max(jr, 0)
+    cs = is_rope.select(ld_f32(a["cos_sin"], pos * ROPE + jj), fx.Float32(1.0))
+    sn = is_rope.select(ld_f32(a["cos_sin"], pos * ROPE + HALF + jj), fx.Float32(0.0))
+    specs = [(c["qkvp"], t * QKV_ROWS + qc[j], 1) for j in range(8)]
+    specs += [(c["qkvp"], t * QKV_ROWS + Q_RANK + tt * 2 + j, 1) for j in range(2)]
+    got = c["mb"].poll(specs, "front_qkvp")
+    vals = [bf16_round(got[j][0].bitcast(fx.Float32)) for j in range(10)]
+    xq = [((tt * 8 + j) < Q_RANK).select(vals[j], fx.Float32(0.0)) for j in range(8)]
+    xk = vals[8:10]
+    ssq = xq[0] * xq[0]
+    for j in range_constexpr(1, 8):
+        ssq = ssq + xq[j] * xq[j]
+    ssq = butterfly(ssq, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+    # kv's sum of squares in the order of SGLang's K store (fused_k_norm_rope_flashmla, gfx950)
+    ssk = butterfly(fma(xk[0], xk[0], xk[1] * xk[1]), (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+    if (lane == 0) & mine:
+        fx.ptr_store(ssq, red + wave)
+    if (lane % 32 == 0) & mine:
+        fx.ptr_store(ssk, red + 16 + tt // 32)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    tq = (fx.ptr_load(red + 0) + fx.ptr_load(red + 1)) + (
+        fx.ptr_load(red + 2) + fx.ptr_load(red + 3)
+    )
+    pk = [fx.ptr_load(red + 16 + w) for w in range(8)]
+    tk = ((pk[0] + pk[4]) + (pk[2] + pk[6])) + ((pk[1] + pk[5]) + (pk[3] + pk[7]))
+    rq = hw_rsq(
+        div_rn(tq, fx.Float32(float(Q_RANK)), fx.Float32(1.0 / Q_RANK))
+        + fx.Float32(EPS)
+    )
+    rk = hw_rsq(
+        div_rn(tk, fx.Float32(float(KV_DIM)), fx.Float32(1.0 / KV_DIM))
+        + fx.Float32(EPS)
+    )
+    # q: bf16 normed row, then vLLM's MXFP8 (a 32-group = 4 threads)
+    ys = [bf16_round((xq[j] * rq) * qw[j]) for j in range(8)]
+    amax = abs(ys[0])
+    for y in ys[1:]:
+        amax = fx.max(amax, abs(y))
+    code = mx_code(butterfly(amax, (1, 2), fx.max))

+        else:
+            if (row0 + rpr * i < n) & (tid < rpr * wq):
+                fx.ptr_store(regs[i], base + i * rpr * lrow)
+
+
+def rows_store(c, regs, words, groups, xl, xsl, n, row_w=None, row_g=None):
+    """Store ``rows_loads``' registers into LDS rows 0 .. n."""
+    _store_span(c, regs[0], words, xl, n, row_w)
+    _store_span(c, regs[1], groups, xsl, n, row_g)
+    gpu.barrier()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""K1 geometry and scratch layout."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+HIDDEN = 5120
+Q_RANK = 1280
+KV_DIM = 512
+QKV_ROWS = Q_RANK + KV_DIM  # 1792
+HEAD_DIM = 512
+NOPE = 448
+ROPE = 64
+HALF = ROPE // 2
+N_HEADS = 64
+EPS = 1e-20
+
+ROWS = 16  # GEMV rows a task
+
+# KV record (V4 fp8_ds_mla): 576 B rows (448 e4m3, 64 bf16), then 8 B of scales a token
+DATA = 576
+
+PAIR = 8  # a mailbox (value, tag) pair
+
+
+def cdiv(a, b):
+    return -(-a // b)
+
+
+def round_up(a, b):
+    return cdiv(a, b) * b
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Dims:
+    tp: int
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        assert self.tp in (2, 4), self.tp
+
+    @property
+    def heads(self) -> int:
+        return N_HEADS // self.tp
+
+    @property
+    def q_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.heads * HEAD_DIM
+
+    @property
+    def wqb_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.q_rows // ROWS
+
+
+WQKV_TASKS = QKV_ROWS // ROWS  # 112
+WQKV_KPARTS = 2  # X8's K halves (a flag each); an LDS window of the wqkv GEMV
+
+
+def wqkv_order(s):
+    """Return SGLang's wqkv_a K order at width s as (chains, halves, sum order)."""
+    if s <= 32:
+        w = 16 if s <= 4 else 8
+        return w, False, tuple(range(w))
+    assert s <= 64
+    return 5, True, (0, 4, 1, 2, 3)
+
+
+def byte_layout(items, start=0, align=256):
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, nbytes in items:
+        off = round_up(off, align)
+        out[name] = (off, nbytes)
+        off += nbytes
+    return out
+
+
+def front_scratch(s: int, d: Dims) -> dict:
+    """Return K1's scratch regions -> (byte offset, bytes)."""
+    return byte_layout(
+        [
+            ("x8", s * HIDDEN),  # e4m3 words (S > 16: quantized once, shared)
+            ("x8s", s * HIDDEN // 32 * 4),  # an i32 code a group
+            ("xrdy", WQKV_KPARTS * s * PAIR),  # a flag a (token, K half)
+            ("qkvp", WQKV_KPARTS * s * QKV_ROWS * PAIR),
+            ("qx8", s * Q_RANK),  # e4m3 words
+            ("qx8s", s * Q_RANK // 32 * 4),  # an i32 code a group
+            ("qrdy", s * PAIR),
+        ]
+    )

+    tp: int

+def scratch_layout(s: int, tp: int) -> dict:
+    """Return each scratch region of width s -> (byte offset, bytes), without overlap."""
+    d = Dims(tp)
+    out: dict = {}
+    off = 0

+    def place(regions):
+        nonlocal off
+        base = off
+        for name, (o, n) in regions.items():
+            if name in out and name not in SHARED_REGIONS:
+                raise ValueError(f"scratch region {name} placed twice")

+@traced
+def store_x8(c, t, col, ys, live):

+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the FFN launch

+@traced

+    """Store the FFN seam's norm output as the MoE input row (bf16, device scope)."""
+    if live:
+        for j in range_constexpr(8):
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                ys[j].to(fx.BFloat16),
+                rsrc(normed),
+                t * HIDDEN + col + j,
+                cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+            )
+
+
+def _seam_lds(s):
+    @fx.struct
+    class SeamLds:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 2 * 64 * 4, 16]
+        rl: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * seam.KT, 16]
+        fl: fx.Array[fx.Float32, seam.MIX * seam.KT, 16]
+        pl: fx.Array[fx.Float32, s * seam.COLS, 16]
+
+    return SeamLds
+
+
+@traced
+def run_ffn(key: MonoBuild, lds, a: dict, amb, bases, own, rank, ep, part=None):
+    """Run the FFN seam, the MoE, its all-reduce into ``a["out"]``, and the epoch update."""
+    s, tp = key.tokens, key.tp
+    layout = scratch_layout(s, tp)
+    mkey = _moe_key(key)
+    rs = route_shape(mkey)
+    GATE0 = SLICES
+    NORM0 = SLICES + s
+    bid = fx.block_idx.x
+    tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+    sl = lds.seam.peek()
+    scratch = a["scratch"]
+    seam_args = (
+        "res_in",
+        "post_in",
+        "comb_in",
+        "pre_in",
+        "hc_fn",
+        "hc_scale",
+        "hc_base",
+        "res_out",
+        "post_out",
+        "comb_out",
+        "pre_out",
+    )
+    ca = {
+        "S": s,
+        "tid": tid,
+        "bid": bid,
+        "lane": tid % 64,
+        "wave": tid // 64,
+        "rl": sl.rl.ptr,
+        "fl": sl.fl.ptr,
+        "red": sl.red.ptr,
+        "pend_lds": sl.pl.ptr,
+        "put": amb.put,
+        "put_bf": amb.put_bf,
+        "put_words": amb.put_words,
+        "poll": amb.poll,
+        "peer_addr": lambda p: bases[p],
+        "rank": rank,
+        "sym": own,
+        "args": {n: a[n] for n in seam_args} | {"norm_w": a["ffn_w"]},
+        "d": StageDims(tp),
+    }
+    normed = scratch + fx.Int64(layout["normed"][0])
+    for region in ("lin", "pmix"):
+        ca[region] = sreg(scratch, layout[region][0], region)
+    mlayout = {n: layout[n] for n in moe.scratch_layout(mkey) if n not in COUNTERS}
+    mlayout["xrdy"] = layout["xrdy_moe"]
+    margs = moe.moe_args(
+        normed,
+        a["gate_w"],
+        a["bias"],
+        a["w13"],
+        a["w13_s"],
+        a["w2"],
+        a["w2_s"],
+        a["sgu"],
+        a["sgu_s"],
+        a["sw2"],
+        a["sw2_s"],
+        a["out"],
+    )
+    cb = moe.moe_context(
+        s, rs, lds.moe.peek(), amb, bases, mlayout, scratch, margs, rank, own
+    )
+    cb["tag"] = ep & 255
+    for i, region in enumerate(COUNTERS):
+        cb[region] = sreg(a["epoch"], 4 * (EPOCH_COUNTERS + i * moe.TAGS), region)
+    for task in range(first_task(bid, 0), SLICES, BLOCKS):
+        if const_expr(part is not None):
+            seam.stage_push(ca, task, part)
+        seam.stage_reduce(ca, task)
+        seam.stage_slice(ca, task)
+    for t in range(first_task(bid, GATE0), s, BLOCKS):
+        seam.stage_gate(ca, t)
+    for t in range(first_task(bid, NORM0), s, BLOCKS):
+        seam.stage_norm(ca, t, lambda *v: store_normed(normed, *v))
+        publish(cb["put"], cb["xrdy"], t, 1, tid == 0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+    # ---- the MoE, its all-reduce into ``out``
+    moe.run_moe(cb, mkey, bid)
+
+    def reset():
+        # the MoE counter slot 128 launch pairs ahead: its last use is long done
+        slot = (ep + 128) & 255
+        for region in COUNTERS:
+            gstore(cb[region].value + fx.Int64(slot * 4), fx.Int32(0), words=1)
+
+    epoch_end({"bid": bid, "tid": tid}, a["epoch"], ep, reset, amb.guard)
+
+
+def build_mono_ffn(key: MonoBuild):
+    """Build the FFN launch: push this rank's wo_b partial, then ``run_ffn``."""
+    s, tp = key.tokens, key.tp
+    _check_width(s)
+    rs = route_shape(_moe_key(key))
+    if rs.experts // 64 not in SORT_NETS:
+        raise ValueError(f"no sort network for {rs.experts} experts")
+    MoeLds = moe.moe_smem(s, rs)
+    half = peer_half_bytes(tp)
+    if SLICES + 2 * s > BLOCKS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"the FFN launch at {s} rows needs {SLICES + 2 * s} CTAs; it has {BLOCKS}"
+        )
+    SeamLds = _seam_lds(s)
+
+    @fx.union
+    class FfnLds:
+        seam: SeamLds  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+        moe: MoeLds  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+
+    name = kernel_symbol("dsv41_mono_ffn", s=s, tp=tp)
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, SOURCES)
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kffn(
+        part: Int64,
+        res_in: Int64,
+        post_in: Int64,
+        comb_in: Int64,
+        pre_in: Int64,
+        hc_fn: Int64,
+        hc_scale: Int64,
+        hc_base: Int64,
+        ffn_w: Int64,
+        res_out: Int64,
+        post_out: Int64,
+        comb_out: Int64,
+        pre_out: Int64,
