+def _e8m0(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A linear's f32 32 x 32 block scales as the E8M0 codes K1 reads: a power of two's exponent bits."""
+    if scale.dtype != torch.float32:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"K1 needs f32 block scales, got {scale.dtype}")
+    bits = scale.contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+    if not bool(((bits & 0x807FFFFF) == 0).all()):
+        raise RuntimeError("K1 needs power-of-two (ue8m0) block scales")
+    return (bits >> 23).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _ffn_weights(layer, shared: dict, state, tp: int):
+    from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.runner import (
+        MonoLayerWeights,
+    )
+
+    i, moe = layer.layer_id, layer.mlp
+    sh = {(p, k): shared.get((i, p, k)) for p in _SHARED for k in ("weight", "scale")}
+    missing = sorted(f"{p} {k}" for (p, k), t in sh.items() if t is None)
+    if missing:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"layer {i}: no shared-expert shards for {missing}")
+    # n: the routed experts, before a fused shared one
+    e, n = moe.experts, moe.gate.weight.shape[0]
+
+    def u8(t):
+        return t.view(torch.uint8)
+
+    w = MonoLayerWeights(
+        hc_ffn_fn=layer.hc_ffn_fn,
+        hc_ffn_scale=layer.hc_ffn_scale,
+        hc_ffn_base=layer.hc_ffn_base,
+        ffn_norm=layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight,
+        gate_w=moe.gate.weight,
+        # SGLang routes with a bf16 copy of the f32 checkpoint bias; the kernels read f32
+        bias=state.keep(
+            f"layer {i} router bias f32", moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias.float()
+        ),
+        w13=e.w13_weight[:n],
+        w13_s=u8(e.w13_weight_scale_inv)[: n * e.w13_weight.shape[1]],
+        w2=e.w2_weight[:n],
+        w2_s=u8(e.w2_weight_scale_inv)[: n * e.w2_weight.shape[1]],
+        sgu=state.keep(
+            f"layer {i} shared gate_up",
+            torch.cat([sh["gate_proj", "weight"], sh["up_proj", "weight"]]).view(
+                torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            ),
+        ),
+        sgu_s=state.keep(
+            f"layer {i} shared gate_up scale",
+            torch.cat([sh["gate_proj", "scale"], sh["up_proj", "scale"]]),
+        ),
+        sw2=sh["down_proj", "weight"].view(torch.float8_e4m3fn),
+        sw2_s=sh["down_proj", "scale"],
+    )
+    w.check(tp)
+    return w
+
+
+def _k1_weights(layer, plain: tuple, cos_sin: torch.Tensor) -> dict:
+    a = layer.self_attn
+
+    def fp8(lin, copy, shape):
+        # the FP8 linear method may have rewritten the weight in place; K1 reads the row-major copy then
+        shuffled = getattr(lin, "aiter_bpreshuffled", False) or getattr(
+            lin, "mxfp8_native_ready", False
+        )
+        w = copy if shuffled else lin.weight
+        s = _e8m0(lin.weight_scale_inv)
+        if not (
+            tuple(w.shape) == shape
+            and w.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+            and w.is_contiguous()
+            and tuple(s.shape) == (shape[0] // 32, shape[1] // 32)
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"K1: weight {tuple(w.shape)} {w.dtype}, scales {tuple(s.shape)}, want {shape}"
+            )
+        return w, s
+
+    wqkv, wqkv_s = fp8(a.wqkv_a, plain[0], (1792, 5120))
+    wqb, wqb_s = fp8(a.wq_b, plain[1], (a.n_local_heads * 512, 1280))
+    w = dict(
+        hc_fn=layer.hc_attn_fn,
+        hc_scale=layer.hc_attn_scale,
+        hc_base=layer.hc_attn_base,
+        norm=layer.input_layernorm.weight,
+        wqkv=wqkv,
+        wqkv_s=wqkv_s,
+        q_norm=a.q_norm.weight,
+        kv_norm=a.kv_norm.weight,
+        wqb=wqb,
+        wqb_s=wqb_s,
+        cos_sin=cos_sin,
+    )
+    bad = [name for name, t in w.items() if not (t.is_contiguous() and t.is_cuda)]
+    if (
+        bad
+        or w["hc_fn"].dtype != torch.float32
+        or not (w["q_norm"].dtype == w["kv_norm"].dtype == torch.bfloat16)
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"K1: unexpected weights {bad or 'dtypes'}")
+    if not (
+        cos_sin.dtype == torch.float32 and cos_sin.dim() == 2 and cos_sin.shape[1] == 64
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"K1: rope table {tuple(cos_sin.shape)} {cos_sin.dtype}, want [positions, 64] f32"
+        )
+    return w
+
+
+def _warm_normal_path(moe, device: torch.device) -> float:
+    """Run the normal MoE path once at widths 1 to MAX_ROWS, so no later step compiles its kernels."""
+    t0 = time.perf_counter()
+    x = torch.randn(
+        MAX_ROWS, _MODEL["hidden_size"], dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device
+    )
+    for m in range(1, MAX_ROWS + 1):
+        # per rank, no collective
+        moe.forward_normal(x[:m], return_moe_output=True)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize(device)
+    return time.perf_counter() - t0
+
+
+class _FfnSpan:
+    def __init__(self, mono, layer_id: int):
+        self.mono, self.layer_id = mono, layer_id
+
+    def __call__(self, part, residual, post, comb, pre):
+        """wo_b's unreduced output and the seam state -> (MoE output, residual, post, comb, pre)."""
+        out, residual, post, comb, pre = self.mono.runner.ffn(
+            self.mono.ffn_w[self.layer_id],
+            part,
+            residual,
+            post,
+            comb,
+            pre,
+            self.layer_id,
+        )
+        return out, residual, post.view(post.shape[0], -1), comb, pre
+
+
+class _K1Span:
+    def __init__(self, mono, layer_id: int, first: bool):
+        self.mono, self.layer_id, self.first = mono, layer_id, first
+
+    def __call__(self, positions, forward_batch, pending_post, prev_pre):
+        """The previous layer's pending post and this layer's attention front -> (q, residual, post, comb, pre);
+        the step's KV rows are written to the SWA cache."""
+        from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.runner import (
+            HC,
+            check_rows,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import (
+            get_attn_backend,
+            get_token_to_kv_pool,
+        )
+
+        if pending_post is None:
+            raise MonokernelError(
+                f"{SWITCH}: k1 on layer {self.layer_id} without the previous layer's pending post"
+            )
+        x, residual, post, comb = pending_post
+        r, w, lid = self.mono.runner, self.mono.k1_w[self.layer_id], self.layer_id
+        M = x.shape[0]
+        slot = get_attn_backend().get_swa_out_cache_loc(forward_batch)
+        # K1 writes through raw pointers: a layout it does not expect would corrupt memory, not fault
+        if not (1 <= M <= MAX_ROWS and slot.shape[0] >= M and positions.shape[0] >= M):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"K1: {M} rows, {tuple(slot.shape)} SWA slots, {tuple(positions.shape)} positions"
+            )
+        bf, f32 = torch.bfloat16, torch.float32
+        hidden = _MODEL["hidden_size"]
+        check_rows(
+            "K1",
+            M,
+            r.device,
+            {
+                "x": (x, hidden, bf),
+                "residual": (residual, HC * hidden, bf),
+                "post": (post, HC, f32),
+                "comb": (comb, HC * HC, f32),
+                "pre": (prev_pre, HC, f32),
+            },
+        )
+        if r.q.shape[1] != self.mono.heads:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"K1: q buffer {tuple(r.q.shape)}, {self.mono.heads} heads"
+            )
+        # the plan's first K1 layer copies the step's positions and slots into the persistent buffers, so a
+        # graph capture records the copy
+        if self.first:
+            r.pos64[:M].copy_(positions[:M])
+            r.slot64[:M].copy_(slot[:M])
+        pool = get_token_to_kv_pool()
+        if pool.request_window is not None or pool.uniform_fp8:
+            raise RuntimeError("K1 needs the paged V4 SWA pool")
+        swa = pool.get_swa_raw_buffer(lid)
+        block = pool.get_swa_key_page_size()
+        if not (
+            swa.dtype == torch.uint8
+            and swa.dim() == 2
+            and swa.stride(0) >= block * 584
+            and swa.stride(1) == 1
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"K1: SWA cache {swa.dtype} {tuple(swa.shape)} {swa.stride()}, page {block} x 584 B"
+            )
+        r.kernel(M, "k1")(
+            residual.data_ptr(),
+            x.data_ptr(),
+            post.data_ptr(),
+            comb.data_ptr(),
+            prev_pre.data_ptr(),
+            w["hc_fn"].data_ptr(),
+            w["hc_scale"].data_ptr(),
+            w["hc_base"].data_ptr(),
+            w["norm"].data_ptr(),
+            r.res_mid.data_ptr(),
+            r.post_a.data_ptr(),
+            r.comb_a.data_ptr(),
+            r.pre_a.data_ptr(),
+            w["wqkv"].data_ptr(),
+            w["wqkv_s"].data_ptr(),
+            w["q_norm"].data_ptr(),
+            w["kv_norm"].data_ptr(),
+            w["wqb"].data_ptr(),
+            w["wqb_s"].data_ptr(),
+            w["cos_sin"].data_ptr(),
+            r.pos64.data_ptr(),
+            r.slot64.data_ptr(),
+            swa.data_ptr(),
+            swa.stride(0),
+            block,
+            r.q.data_ptr(),
+            r.scratch(M).data_ptr(),
+            r.epoch.data_ptr(),
+            stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+        )
+        return r.q[:M], r.res_mid[:M], r.post_a[:M], r.comb_a[:M], r.pre_a[:M]
+

+class DSV41Mono:
+    """DeepSeek-V4.1's attached monokernels on one rank: the runner, the bound weights, and the spans."""
+
+    def __init__(self, ctx, owner, state):
+        from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.runner import (
+            DSV41MonoLayer,
+        )
+
+        model = owner.model
+        plan = spans(owner, StepKind.DECODE).layers
+        ffn_ids = [i for i, s in plan.items() if FFN in s and FFN.name in ctx.spans]
+        k1_ids = [i for i, s in plan.items() if K1 in s and K1.name in ctx.spans]
+        self.runner = DSV41MonoLayer(
+            ctx.tp_size, ctx.tp_rank, ctx.group, ctx.device, ctx.deadline_s, ctx.fault
+        )
+        shared = state.data.get("shared", {})
+        self.ffn_w = {
+            i: _ffn_weights(model.layers[i], shared, state, ctx.tp_size)
+            for i in ffn_ids
+        }
+        state.data.pop("shared", None)
+        plain = state.data.pop("k1_plain", {})
+        missing = [i for i in k1_ids if i not in plain]
+        if missing:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"no row-major wqkv_a / wq_b copies for K1 layers {missing}"
+            )
+        tables: list = []
+        self.k1_w = {}
+        for i in k1_ids:
+            a = model.layers[i].self_attn
+            cos_sin = next((t for f, t in tables if f is a.freqs_cis), None)
+            if cos_sin is None:
+                cos_sin = state.keep(
+                    f"rope table {len(tables)}",
+                    torch.cat([a.freqs_cis.real, a.freqs_cis.imag], -1)
+                    .float()
+                    .contiguous(),
+                )
+                tables.append((a.freqs_cis, cos_sin))
+            self.k1_w[i] = _k1_weights(model.layers[i], plain[i], cos_sin)
+        self.heads = model.layers[k1_ids[0]].self_attn.n_local_heads if k1_ids else 0
+        self.warm_s = (
+            _warm_normal_path(model.layers[ffn_ids[0]].mlp, ctx.device)
+            if ffn_ids
+            else 0.0
+        )
+
+    def allocate(self, widths) -> dict:
+        scratch = self.runner.allocate(widths)
+        persistent = self.runner.persistent_bytes()
+        return {
+            "persistent MiB": round(sum(persistent.values()) / 2**20, 1),
+            "scratch MiB per width": {
+                w: round(b / 2**20, 2) for w, b in scratch.items()
+            },
+            "normal-path warm-up s": round(self.warm_s, 1),
+        }
+
+    def build_widths(self, widths) -> dict:
+        return self.runner.build(widths, k1=bool(self.k1_w))
+
+    def check_numerics(self, owner, widths) -> dict:
+        """The ffn span against SGLang's normal path on the loaded weights (RFC section 10): the same seam inputs
+        through the attention all-reduce, the mHC boundary, the post-attention norm and the layer's MoE
+        (forward_normal, with its all-reduce), at every width, on the first, a middle and the last ffn layer.
+        Runs collectives in the same order on every rank. Returns {(width, key): value}."""
+        from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.runner import HC
+        from sglang.experimental.monokernels.spec import measure
+        from sglang.srt.distributed.communication_op import (
+            tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.models.deepseek_common.amd.deepseek_v4_fused_mhc import (
+            _gfx95_dense_post_attention_norm,
+            hc_boundary,
+        )
+
+        ids = sorted(self.ffn_w)
+        layers = sorted({ids[0], ids[len(ids) // 2], ids[-1]}) if ids else []
+        dev, hidden = self.runner.device, _MODEL["hidden_size"]
+        rank, tp = self.runner.rank, self.runner.tp
+        out: dict = {}
+        for M in widths:
+            g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(11 + M)
+            res = torch.randn(M, HC, hidden, generator=g, device=dev)
+            res = (res * torch.rsqrt(res.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True))).to(
+                torch.bfloat16
+            )
+            comb = torch.rand(M, HC, HC, generator=g, device=dev) + 0.1
+            for _ in range(20):
+                comb = comb / comb.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+                comb = comb / comb.sum(-2, keepdim=True)
+            post = torch.sigmoid(torch.randn(M, HC, generator=g, device=dev)) * 2
+            pre = torch.sigmoid(torch.randn(M, HC, generator=g, device=dev)) + 1e-6
+            gp = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(100 + 7 * rank + M)
+            part = (torch.randn(M, hidden, generator=gp, device=dev) * 0.5 / tp).to(
+                torch.bfloat16
+            )
+            for i in layers:
+                layer = owner.model.layers[i]
+                got = [
+                    t.clone()
+                    for t in self.runner.ffn(
+                        self.ffn_w[i], part, res, post, comb.contiguous(), pre, i
+                    )
+                ]
+                x = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(part.clone())
+                res2, y, co = hc_boundary(
+                    layer, x, res, post, comb.contiguous(), pre,
+                    layer.hc_ffn_fn, layer.hc_ffn_scale, layer.hc_ffn_base,
+                )  # fmt: skip
+                normed = _gfx95_dense_post_attention_norm(layer, y, co)
+                ref_out = layer.mlp.forward_normal(normed)
+                pre_n, post_n, comb_n = co.tensors()
+                refs = (ref_out, res2, post_n, comb_n, pre_n)
+                for name, a, b in zip(
+                    ("out", "residual", "post", "comb", "pre"), got, refs
+                ):
+                    m = measure(a.float().reshape(b.shape), b.float())
+                    for metric, v in m.items():
+                        key = (M, f"ffn.{name}.{metric}")
+                        out[key] = max(out.get(key, 0.0), v)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize(dev)
+        return out
+
+    def span(self, plan, layer_id: int, span: Span):
+        if span == K1:
+            return _K1Span(self, layer_id, plan.first.get(K1.name) == layer_id)
+        if span == FFN:
+            return _FfnSpan(self, layer_id)
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown span {span}")
+
+
+def build(ctx, owner, state) -> DSV41Mono:
+    return DSV41Mono(ctx, owner, state)
+

+        self.stage = "loading"
+        self.data: dict = {}
+        self.copies: dict = {}
+
+    def keep(self, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Record a weight copy the kernels keep; the log lists each with its size."""
+        self.copies[name] = tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+        return tensor
+
+
+def enabled() -> bool:
+    return bool(get_exec().features.enable_monokernel)
+
+
+def _load_state(owner) -> Optional[LoadState]:
+    state = getattr(owner, "_monokernel_load", None)
+    if state is None:
+        spec = load_spec(type(owner).__name__) if enabled() else None
+        state = LoadState(spec) if spec is not None else False
+        owner._monokernel_load = state
+    return state or None
+
+
+def load_tensor(owner, name: str, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Each checkpoint tensor before the loader renames or quantizes it: the spec may keep a copy."""
+    state = _load_state(owner)
+    if state is not None and state.spec.load_tensor is not None:
+        if state.stage != "loading":
+            raise MonokernelError(f"{SWITCH}: a checkpoint tensor after {state.stage}")
+        state.spec.load_tensor(state, owner, name, tensor)
+    return tensor
+
+
+def loaded(owner) -> None:
+    """The end of load_weights, before process_weights_after_loading rewrites weights in place."""
+    state = _load_state(owner)
+    if state is None:
+        return
+    if state.stage != "loading":
+        raise MonokernelError(f"{SWITCH}: loaded() after {state.stage}")
+    if state.spec.loaded is not None:
+        state.spec.loaded(state, owner)
+    state.stage = "loaded"
+
+
+def _fault(spec: MonoSpec, tp_rank: int) -> Optional[tuple]:
+    """This rank's injected fault (site, after), or None; the value was checked by the config hook."""
+    fault, reasons = fault_injection(spec)
+    if reasons:
+        raise MonoRefused("; ".join(reasons))
+    if fault is None or fault[0] != tp_rank:
+        return None
+    return fault[1], fault[2]
+
+
+def _context(spec: MonoSpec) -> MonoContext:
+    p = get_parallel()
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+    isa = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(device).gcnArchName.split(":")[0]
+    return MonoContext(
+        tp_rank=p.tp_rank,
+        tp_size=p.tp_size,
+        group=p.tp_group.cpu_group,
+        device=device,
+        isa=isa,
+        deadline_s=deadline_s(get_device().watchdog_timeout),
+        spans=span_selection(spec)[0],
+        fault=_fault(spec, p.tp_rank),
+    )
+
+
+def _gather(ctx: MonoContext, value) -> list:
+    if ctx.tp_size == 1:
+        return [value]
+    everyone = [None] * ctx.tp_size
+    dist.all_gather_object(everyone, value, group=ctx.group)
+    return everyone
+
+
+def agree(ctx: MonoContext, spec_name: str, stage: str, fn):
+    """Run ``fn() -> (reasons, value)`` on this rank, then exchange every rank's reasons before any rank
+    raises, so no rank is left waiting in a collective that its peers abandoned."""
+    try:
+        reasons, value = fn()
+    except Exception as err:
+        reasons, value = [f"{type(err).__name__}: {err}"], None
+    everyone = _gather(ctx, [str(r) for r in reasons])
+    raise_refused(
+        spec_name,
+        stage,
+        [f"rank {r}: {m}" for r, rs in enumerate(everyone) for m in rs],
+    )
+    return value
+
+
+def widths_for(sizes, verify_tokens: Optional[int], max_rows: int) -> dict:
+    """Step rows a graph capture can reach, capped at the kernels' largest width: the decode capture sizes, or
+    with speculative decoding (the target then runs verify steps, not decode steps) those sizes times the tokens
+    a request verifies. The kernel tests take their widths from here too."""
+    sizes = sorted({int(b) for b in sizes})
+    if verify_tokens is None:
+        return {StepKind.DECODE: tuple(b for b in sizes if 1 <= b <= max_rows)}
+    if verify_tokens < 1:
+        raise MonoRefused(
+            f"{SWITCH}: speculative decoding with {verify_tokens} tokens a verify step"
+        )
+    return {
+        StepKind.TARGET_VERIFY: tuple(
+            b * verify_tokens for b in sizes if 1 <= b * verify_tokens <= max_rows
+        )
+    }
+
+
+def _verify_tokens() -> Optional[int]:
+    if get_spec().speculative_algorithm is None:
+        return None
+    return int(get_spec().speculative_num_draft_tokens or 0)
+
+
+def reachable_widths(max_rows: int) -> dict:
+    return widths_for(
+        get_exec().graph.cuda_graph_config.decode.bs, _verify_tokens(), max_rows
+    )
+
+
+def _digest(layers: Mapping[int, tuple]) -> str:
+    items = sorted(
+        (i, tuple((s.name, int(s.start), int(s.end)) for s in spans))
+        for i, spans in layers.items()
+    )
+    return hashlib.sha1(repr(items).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
+
+
+class MonoRuntime:
+    """A model's attached monokernels in this process."""
+
+    def __init__(self, spec: MonoSpec, ctx: MonoContext, owner, state: LoadState):
+        self.spec, self.ctx, self.owner, self.state = spec, ctx, owner, state
+        self.plans: dict = {}
+        self.firsts: dict = {}
+        self.widths: dict = {}
+        self.verify_tokens: Optional[int] = None
+        self.model = None
+        self._unbuilt: set = set()
+
+    def _local_plan(self, kind: StepKind) -> tuple:
+        sp = self.spec.spans(self.owner, kind)
+        layers = {}
+        for i, spans in sp.layers.items():
+            kept = tuple(s for s in spans if s.name in self.ctx.spans)
+            if kept:
+                check_layer_spans(i, kept)
+                layers[i] = kept
+        return layers, sp.notes
+
+    def _plan(self, kind: StepKind) -> dict:
+        """This step type's spans per layer: built on each rank, then the same digest on every rank or
+        startup stops."""
+        layers, notes = agree(
+            self.ctx,
+            self.spec.name,
+            f"the {kind.value} plan",
+            lambda: ([], self._local_plan(kind)),
+        )
+        digest = _digest(layers)
+        digests = _gather(self.ctx, digest)
+        if len(set(digests)) != 1:
+            raise_refused(
+                self.spec.name,
+                f"the {kind.value} plan",
+                [f"rank {r}: plan {d}" for r, d in enumerate(digests)],
+            )
+        first: dict = {}
+        for i in sorted(layers):
+            for s in layers[i]:
+                first.setdefault(s.name, i)
+        self.firsts[kind] = first
+        if self.ctx.tp_rank == 0:
+            counts: dict = {}
+            for spans in layers.values():
+                for s in spans:
+                    counts[s.name] = counts.get(s.name, 0) + 1
+            logger.info(
+                "%s %s: %s plan %s: %d layers, spans %s",
+                SWITCH,
+                self.spec.name,
+                kind.value,
+                digest,
+                len(layers),
+                counts,
+            )
+            for note in notes:
+                logger.info(
+                    "%s %s: %s plan: %s", SWITCH, self.spec.name, kind.value, note
+                )
+        return layers
+
+    def _model_reasons(self, limits) -> list:
+        s, ctx = self.spec, self.ctx
+        if limits is None:
+            return [f"no {s.name} kernels for {ctx.isa}"]
+        reasons = []
+        if ctx.tp_size not in limits.tp_sizes:
+            reasons.append(
+                f"TP {ctx.tp_size}; the kernels serve TP {list(limits.tp_sizes)}"
+            )
+        return reasons + list(s.model_disable_reasons(self.owner))
+
+    def attach(self) -> None:
+        t0 = time.perf_counter()
+        s, ctx = self.spec, self.ctx
+        limits = s.devices.get(ctx.isa)
+        agree(ctx, s.name, "model checks", lambda: (self._model_reasons(limits), None))
+        self.plans[StepKind.DECODE] = self._plan(StepKind.DECODE)
+        self.verify_tokens = _verify_tokens()
+        self.widths = reachable_widths(limits.max_rows)
+        all_widths = sorted(set().union(*self.widths.values()))
+        agree(
+            ctx,
+            s.name,
+            "widths",
+            lambda: (
+                []
+                if all_widths
+                else [
+                    f"no captured step width is within the kernels' {limits.max_rows} rows: every step "
+                    "would take the model path"
+                ],
+                None,
+            ),
+        )
+        self.model = agree(
+            ctx,
+            s.name,
+            "weight views",
+            lambda: ([], s.build(ctx, self.owner, self.state)),
+        )
+        memory = agree(
+            ctx, s.name, "memory", lambda: ([], self.model.allocate(all_widths))
+        )
+        # one agreement after every width: the build loop runs no collective, so a rank that fails one width
+        # cannot leave a peer waiting inside the loop
+        builds = agree(
+            ctx,
+            s.name,
+            "kernel builds",
+            lambda: ([], self.model.build_widths(all_widths)),
+        )
+        check = (envs.SGLANG_TEST_MONO_CHECK_NUMERICS.get() or "").strip()
+        if check and hasattr(self.model, "check_numerics"):
+            self._check_numerics(check, all_widths)
+        # the kernels hold views and copies of the loaded weights
+        self.owner._derived_weight_cache_error = (
+            f"Online weight updates are not supported with {SWITCH}: the {s.name} "
+            "monokernels hold views and copies of the loaded weights."
+        )
+        self.state.stage = "attached"
+        if ctx.tp_rank == 0:
+            copies = self.state.copies
+            logger.info(
+                "%s %s: weight copies %s (total %.1f MiB)",
+                SWITCH,
+                s.name,
+                {k: f"{v / 2**20:.1f} MiB" for k, v in sorted(copies.items())},
+                sum(copies.values()) / 2**20,
+            )
+            logger.info(
+                "%s %s: widths %s; memory %s; builds %s; attached in %.1f s",
+                SWITCH,
+                s.name,
+                {k.value: list(v) for k, v in self.widths.items()},
+                memory,
+                builds,
+                time.perf_counter() - t0,
+            )
+
+    def _check_numerics(self, mode: str, widths) -> None:
+        """SGLANG_TEST_MONO_CHECK_NUMERICS=log|enforce: the spans against the normal path on the loaded weights at
+        every built width, logged per width; enforce refuses startup above the spec's bounds."""
+        values = self.model.check_numerics(self.owner, widths)
+        bounds = self.spec.numerics.bounds
+        over = sorted(
+            f"{w} rows: {k} {v:.3g} > {bounds[k]:.3g}"
+            for (w, k), v in values.items()
+            if bounds.get(k) is not None and v > bounds[k]
+        )
+        if self.ctx.tp_rank == 0:
+            for w in sorted({w for w, _ in values}):
+                logger.info(
+                    "%s %s: against the normal path at %d rows: %s",
+                    SWITCH,
+                    self.spec.name,
+                    w,
+                    {
+                        k: float(f"{v:.3g}")
+                        for (r, k), v in sorted(values.items())
+                        if r == w
+                    },
+                )
+        agree(
+            self.ctx,
+            self.spec.name,
+            "numerics against the normal path",
+            lambda: (over if mode == "enforce" else [], None),
+        )
+
+    def route(self, forward_batch) -> Optional[Plan]:
+        mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        if mode.is_decode():
+            kind = StepKind.DECODE
+        elif mode.is_target_verify():
+            kind = StepKind.TARGET_VERIFY
+        else:
+            return None
+        rows, bs = int(forward_batch.input_ids.shape[0]), int(forward_batch.batch_size)
+        want = bs if kind is StepKind.DECODE else bs * (self.verify_tokens or 0)
+        if bs <= 0 or rows != want:
+            raise MonokernelError(
+                f"{SWITCH}: a {kind.value} step of {rows} rows for {bs} requests (want {want})"
+            )
+        if rows not in self.widths.get(kind, ()):
+            if (kind, rows) not in self._unbuilt and self.ctx.tp_rank == 0:
+                logger.info(
+                    "%s: %s steps of %d rows take the model path (no width built)",
+                    SWITCH,
+                    kind.value,
+                    rows,
+                )
+            self._unbuilt.add((kind, rows))
+            return None
+        layers = self.plans.get(kind)
+        if layers is None:
+            # the verify plan waits for DSpark's capture layers, set after loading; every rank reaches this
+            # point in the same capture warm-up, so its digest is compared there, before any verify step runs
+            layers = self.plans[kind] = self._plan(kind)
+        if (
+            self.ctx.tp_rank == 0
+            and torch.cuda.is_available()
+            and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        ):
+            logger.info(
+                "%s: captured %s %d rows on monokernels (%d layers)",
+                SWITCH,
+                kind.value,
+                rows,
+                len(layers),
+            )
+        return Plan(kind, rows, layers, self.firsts[kind], self)
+
+
+def attach(owner) -> None:
+    """precompile_kernels_after_loading: refuse on any rank, allocate, build every reachable width."""
+    state = _load_state(owner)
+    if state is None:
+        return
+    if state.stage != "loaded":
+        raise MonokernelError(
+            f"{SWITCH}: attach() before loaded() (stage {state.stage})"
+        )
+    rt = MonoRuntime(state.spec, _context(state.spec), owner, state)
+    rt.attach()
+    owner.model._monokernel = rt
+
+
+def route(model, forward_batch) -> Optional[Plan]:
+    """Once a forward: the plan for this step, or None for the normal path."""
+    rt = getattr(model, "_monokernel", None)
+    return None if rt is None else rt.route(forward_batch)
+
+
+def kernel(plan: Optional[Plan], layer_id: int, point):
+    """The span of layer ``layer_id`` that starts at ``point`` in this step, or None."""
+    if plan is None:
+        return None
+    p = Point.of(point)
+    for s in plan.layers.get(layer_id, ()):
+        if s.start == p:
+            return plan.runtime.model.span(plan, layer_id, s)
+    return None
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "LoadState",
+    "MonoContext",
+    "MonoRuntime",
+    "MonokernelError",
+    "Plan",
+    "attach",
+    "kernel",
+    "load_tensor",
+    "loaded",
+    "route",
+]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""What a model's monokernels cover and support: span points, spans, features, device limits, numerics,
+and the registry from HF architecture to spec (RFC #43949 sections 4-7 and 10)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import enum
+import importlib
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, Optional
+
+
+class Point(enum.IntEnum):
+    """Points inside one decoder layer, in execution order."""
+
+    LAYER_IN = 0
+    ATTN_IN = 1
+    CORE_IN = 2
+    CORE_OUT = 3
+    ATTN_PARTIAL = 4
+    MLP_IN = 5
+    MLP_PARTIAL = 6
+    LAYER_OUT = 7
+
+    @classmethod
+    def of(cls, point) -> "Point":
+        if isinstance(point, Point):
+            return point
+        try:
+            return cls[str(point).upper()]
+        except KeyError:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown span point {point!r}") from None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Span:
+    """One launch's part of a layer. It takes and returns exactly what the code it replaces does."""
+
+    name: str
+    start: Point
+    end: Point
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.end <= self.start:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"span {self.name} must end after it starts ({self.start.name} to {self.end.name})"
+            )
+
+
+def check_layer_spans(layer: int, spans: tuple) -> None:
+    """A layer's spans are ordered and do not overlap; SGLang's own code runs in any gap between them."""
+    for a, b in zip(spans, spans[1:]):
+        if b.start < a.end:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"layer {layer}: span {b.name} starts before {a.name} ends"
+            )
+
+
+class StepKind(enum.Enum):
+    """The step types a monokernel may serve; every other step takes the normal path."""
+
+    DECODE = "decode"
+    TARGET_VERIFY = "target_verify"
+
+
+class Feature(enum.Enum):
+    """Deployment features that a spec refuses unless it lists them."""
+
+    PIPELINE_PARALLEL = "pipeline parallelism"
+    MULTI_NODE_TP = "tensor parallelism across nodes"
+    DP_ATTENTION = "data-parallel attention"
+    EXPERT_PARALLEL = "expert parallelism"
+    EPLB = "expert load balancing"
+    CONTEXT_PARALLEL = "context parallelism"
+    DECODE_CONTEXT_PARALLEL = "decode context parallelism"
+    SPECULATIVE = "speculative decoding"
+    UNEVEN_VERIFY = "verify steps with a different token count per request"
+    TWO_BATCH_OVERLAP = "two-batch overlap"
+    LORA = "LoRA"
+    PD_DISAGGREGATION = "prefill / decode disaggregation"
+    KV_OFFLOAD = "hierarchical KV cache"
+    MEMORY_RELEASE = "memory saver"
+    CPU_OFFLOAD = "CPU offload"
+    WEIGHT_BACKUP = "CPU weight backup"
+    TORCH_COMPILE = "torch-compiled decode"
+    DETERMINISTIC = "deterministic inference"
+    RL_ON_POLICY = "RL on-policy mode"
+    EAGER = "eager decode (no CUDA graphs)"
+    BREAKABLE_DECODE_GRAPH = "breakable decode CUDA graphs"
+    ROUTED_EXPERT_CAPTURE = "returning routed experts"
+    INDEXER_TOPK_CAPTURE = "returning indexer top-k"
+    HIDDEN_STATE_CAPTURE = "returning hidden states"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DeviceLimits:
+    """Per ISA: the largest step the kernels serve (rows), the TP sizes, and the workgroups that stay resident."""
+
+    max_rows: int
+    tp_sizes: tuple[int, ...]
+    resident_blocks: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Requirements:
+    """What the kernels read, for the startup log and the docs."""
+
+    dtypes: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+    kv_cache: str = ""
+    attention_backends: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+    moe_backends: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+
+class Exactness(enum.Enum):
+    BITWISE = "bitwise"
+    TOLERANCE = "tolerance"
+
+
+# modes that accept only a bitwise spec (RFC section 10)
+BITWISE_ONLY = frozenset({Feature.DETERMINISTIC, Feature.RL_ON_POLICY})
+
+
+METRICS = ("max_abs", "max_rel")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Numerics:
+    """Bounds against the normal path on the same GPU, keyed ``<span>.<output>.<metric>``.
+
+    ``max_abs`` = max |out - ref|; ``max_rel`` = max |out - ref| / max |ref|. A bound of None is not set yet:
+    the tests report the measured value and fail nothing for it. A bitwise output has the bound 0."""
+
+    exactness: Exactness
+    bounds: Mapping[str, Optional[float]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        for key, bound in self.bounds.items():
+            parts = key.split(".")
+            if len(parts) != 3 or parts[2] not in METRICS:
+                raise ValueError(f"numerics key {key!r}: want <span>.<output>.<metric>")
+            if bound is not None and not (bound >= 0 and math.isfinite(bound)):
+                raise ValueError(f"numerics bound {key} = {bound!r}")
+        if self.exactness is Exactness.BITWISE and any(self.bounds.values()):
+            raise ValueError("a bitwise spec has only zero bounds")
+
+
+def measure(out, ref) -> dict:
+    """``max_abs`` and ``max_rel`` of ``out`` against ``ref`` (both cast to float64).
+
+    A non-finite value in ``out`` where ``ref`` is finite, or a shape mismatch, gives inf for both. When
+    max |ref| is 0, ``max_rel`` is 0 if the outputs are equal and inf otherwise."""
+    import torch
+
+    if tuple(out.shape) != tuple(ref.shape):
+        return {"max_abs": math.inf, "max_rel": math.inf}
+    o, r = out.double(), ref.double()
+    if bool((~torch.isfinite(o) & torch.isfinite(r)).any()):
+        return {"max_abs": math.inf, "max_rel": math.inf}
+    both = torch.isfinite(o) & torch.isfinite(r)
+    diff = (o - r).abs().where(both, torch.zeros_like(o))
+    max_abs = float(diff.max()) if diff.numel() else 0.0
+    scale = float(r.abs().where(both, torch.zeros_like(r)).max()) if r.numel() else 0.0
+    if scale == 0.0:
+        return {"max_abs": max_abs, "max_rel": 0.0 if max_abs == 0.0 else math.inf}
+    return {"max_abs": max_abs, "max_rel": max_abs / scale}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SpanPlan:
+    """The spans of every covered layer for one step type, and the reasons for layers the step type leaves out."""
+
+    layers: Mapping[int, tuple[Span, ...]]
+    notes: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MonoSpec:
+    """A model's monokernels on one vendor: what they cover, what they accept, and how to build them."""
+
+    name: str
+    devices: Mapping[str, DeviceLimits]
+    features: frozenset
+    requires: Requirements
+    span_names: tuple[str, ...]
+    spans: Callable[[Any, StepKind], SpanPlan]
+    numerics: Numerics
+    config_disable_reasons: Callable[[Any, Any], list]
+    model_disable_reasons: Callable[[Any], list]
+    build: Callable[..., Any]
+    load_tensor: Optional[Callable[..., None]] = None
+    loaded: Optional[Callable[..., None]] = None
+    # the guarded waits' names, for SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT
+    wait_sites: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        loose = sorted(f.value for f in self.features & BITWISE_ONLY)
+        if loose and self.numerics.exactness is not Exactness.BITWISE:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"spec {self.name}: {loose} accept only a bitwise spec; this one is "
+                f"{self.numerics.exactness.value}"
+            )
+
+
+# architecture -> the module whose SPEC serves it, imported only when that model starts with the switch on: the
+# HF architecture (read by the config hook) and the SGLang class that loads it (read by the load hooks)
+REGISTRY: dict = {
+    "DeepseekV41ForCausalLM": "sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.spec",
+    "DeepseekV4ForCausalLM": "sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.spec",
+}
+
+
+def load_spec(arch: str) -> Optional[MonoSpec]:
+    path = REGISTRY.get(arch)
+    if path is None:
+        return None
+    return importlib.import_module(path).SPEC

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Stress chained FFN launches (with ``--k1``: K1 and FFN launches) across widths, width orders and graph replays (torchrun, 4 GPUs)."""
+
+import argparse
+import gc
+import math
+import os
+import random
+import time
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from test_dsv41_ffn import (
+    HC,
+    HIDDEN,
+    WIDTHS,
+    finish,
+    make_weights,
+    mono_weights,
+    seam_inputs,
+)
+
+RECORD, BLOCK, PAGES, POSITIONS = (
+    584,
+    64,
+    64,
+    8192,
+)  # V4 SWA record bytes, page tokens, pages, rope positions
+MODES = ("graph", "graph_delay", "eager", "eager_delay")
+PHASES = 10
+
+
+def delay(us):
+    """Hold this rank's stream for about ``us`` microseconds."""
+    torch.cuda._sleep(int(us * 2400))  # ~2.4 GHz shader clock
+
+
+def attn_weights(heads, dev, g):
+    """Random K1 weights of one layer: e4m3 [N, K] with E8M0 32 x 32 block codes, unit norms."""
+
+    def fp8(n, k):
+        w = (torch.randn(n, k, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.5).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+        s = torch.full((n // 32, k // 32), 121, dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
+        return w, s
+
+    wqkv, wqkv_s = fp8(1792, HIDDEN)
+    wqb, wqb_s = fp8(heads * 512, 1280)
+    one = lambda n: torch.ones(n, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)  # noqa: E731
+    return dict(
+        wqkv=wqkv,
+        wqkv_s=wqkv_s,
+        q_norm=one(1280),
+        kv_norm=one(512),
+        wqb=wqb,
+        wqb_s=wqb_s,
+    )
+
+
+def rope_table(dev):
+    """K1's rope table, [POSITIONS, 64] f32: 32 cosines, then 32 sines."""
+    j = torch.arange(32, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)
+    ang = torch.arange(POSITIONS, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)[
+        :, None
+    ] * 10000.0 ** (-j / 32)
+    return torch.cat([ang.cos(), ang.sin()], -1).float().contiguous()
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--k1", action="store_true", help="run K1 before each FFN launch")
+    ap.add_argument(
+        "--minutes", type=float, default=25.0, help="stress time, split over the phases"
+    )
+    ap.add_argument(
+        "--layers", type=int, default=None, help="default 30 with --k1, else 40"
+    )
+    ap.add_argument(
+        "--sets",
+        type=int,
+        default=None,
+        help="FFN weight sets cycled over the layers (2 with --k1, else 4)",
+    )
+    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=7)
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    rank, tp = int(os.environ["RANK"]), int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(rank)
+    dev = torch.device("cuda", rank)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl")
+    cpu = dist.new_group(backend="gloo")
+    from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.layer import (
+        MonoBuild,
+        build_mono_k1,
+    )
+    from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.runner import (
+        DSV41MonoLayer,
+    )
+
+    def log(msg):
+        if rank == 0:
+            print(f"[{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}] {msg}", flush=True)
+
+    k1 = args.k1
+    L = args.layers or (30 if k1 else 40)
+    kinds = ("out", "residual", "post", "comb", "pre") + (
+        ("q", "records") if k1 else ()
+    )
+    ffn = []
+    for s in range(args.sets or (2 if k1 else 4)):
+        w, _, _ = make_weights(tp, rank, dev, seed=s)
+        ffn.append(mono_weights(w))
+        ffn[-1].check(tp)
+        del w
+        gc.collect()
+        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
+    r = DSV41MonoLayer(tp, rank, cpu, dev, deadline_s=60.0)
+    r.allocate(WIDTHS)
+    r.build(WIDTHS, k1=False)
+    heads = r.q.shape[1]
+    g = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(
+        11
+    )  # the same attention weights on every rank
+    attn = [attn_weights(heads, dev, g) for _ in range(L)] if k1 else None
+    cos_sin = rope_table(dev)
+    stride = math.ceil(BLOCK * RECORD / 576) * 576  # SGLang's V4 page bytes
+    share = (rank + 1) / (
+        tp * (tp + 1) / 2
+    )  # this rank's share of the next layer's attention output
+
+    class Width:
+        """One step width's fixed inputs, its per-layer outputs, and their eager reference."""
+
+        def __init__(self, M):
+            self.M = M
+            self.part, self.res, self.post, self.comb, self.pre = seam_inputs(
+                M, tp, rank, dev
+            )
+            b16, f32 = torch.bfloat16, torch.float32
+            self.bufs = (
+                torch.empty(L, M, HIDDEN, dtype=b16, device=dev),
+                torch.empty(L, M, HC, HIDDEN, dtype=b16, device=dev),
+                torch.empty(L, M, HC, 1, dtype=f32, device=dev),
+                torch.empty(L, M, HC, HC, dtype=f32, device=dev),
+                torch.empty(L, M, HC, dtype=f32, device=dev),
+            )
+            if k1:
+                self.k1 = build_mono_k1(MonoBuild(M, tp))
+                self.x = (torch.randn(M, HIDDEN, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.1).to(
+                    torch.bfloat16
+                )
+                self.pos = torch.randint(0, POSITIONS, (M,), generator=g, device=dev)
+                self.slot = torch.randperm(PAGES * BLOCK, generator=g, device=dev)[:M]
+                self.swa = torch.full(
+                    (PAGES, stride), 255, dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev
+                )
+                self.bufs += (
+                    torch.empty(M, heads, 512, dtype=b16, device=dev),
+                    self.swa,
+                )
+            self.parts = torch.empty(L, M, HIDDEN, dtype=b16, device=dev)
+            self.ref = None
+
+        def poison(self):
+            for b in self.bufs[:6]:
+                b.fill_(float("nan"))
+            if k1:
+                r.q.fill_(float("nan"))
+                self.swa.fill_(255)
+
+    def chain(wd, delay_rank=-1, delay_us=0):
+        M = wd.M
+        part, res, post, comb, pre = wd.part, wd.res, wd.post, wd.comb, wd.pre
+        x = wd.x if k1 else None
+        for i in range(L):
+            if i == L // 2 and rank == delay_rank:
+                delay(delay_us)
+            m = ffn[i % len(ffn)]
+            outs = tuple(b[i] for b in wd.bufs[:5])
+            if k1:
+                a = attn[i]
+                # the attention seam takes the set's mHC and norm weights too
+                wd.k1(
+                    res.data_ptr(), x.data_ptr(), post.data_ptr(), comb.data_ptr(), pre.data_ptr(),
+                    m.hc_ffn_fn.data_ptr(), m.hc_ffn_scale.data_ptr(), m.hc_ffn_base.data_ptr(), m.ffn_norm.data_ptr(),
+                    r.res_mid.data_ptr(), r.post_a.data_ptr(), r.comb_a.data_ptr(), r.pre_a.data_ptr(),
+                    a["wqkv"].data_ptr(), a["wqkv_s"].data_ptr(), a["q_norm"].data_ptr(), a["kv_norm"].data_ptr(),
+                    a["wqb"].data_ptr(), a["wqb_s"].data_ptr(), cos_sin.data_ptr(), wd.pos.data_ptr(),
+                    wd.slot.data_ptr(), wd.swa.data_ptr(), wd.swa.stride(0), BLOCK, r.q.data_ptr(),
+                    r.scratch(M).data_ptr(), r.epoch.data_ptr(), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+                )  # fmt: skip
+                got = r.ffn(
+                    m,
+                    part,
+                    r.res_mid[:M],
+                    r.post_a[:M].view(M, HC, 1),
+                    r.comb_a[:M],
+                    r.pre_a[:M],
+                    i,
+                )
+                for o, t in zip(outs, got):
+                    o.copy_(t.view(o.shape))
+            else:
+                got = r.ffn(m, part, res, post, comb, pre, i)
+                for o, t in zip(outs, got):
+                    o.copy_(t.view(o.shape))
+            torch.mul(wd.bufs[0][i], share, out=wd.parts[i])
+            x, part = wd.bufs[0][i], wd.parts[i]
+            res, post, comb, pre = (b[i] for b in wd.bufs[1:5])
+        if k1:
+            wd.bufs[5].copy_(r.q[:M])
+
+    # eager references: two eager chains per width must agree bit for bit and be finite
+    st = {}
+    fails = []
+    t0 = time.time()
+    for M in sorted(
+        WIDTHS, reverse=True
+    ):  # SGLang warms up and captures the largest width first
+        wd = st[M] = Width(M)
+        chain(wd)
+        chain(wd)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        first = [b.clone() for b in wd.bufs]
+        wd.poison()
+        chain(wd)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        if not all(torch.equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(first, wd.bufs)):
+            fails.append(f"M={M} eager not deterministic")
+        if not all(torch.isfinite(b).all() for b in first[:6]):
+            fails.append(f"M={M} reference not finite")
+        wd.ref = first
+    log(
+        f"tp {tp}, {L} layers ({'K1 + ' if k1 else ''}FFN launch each), widths {WIDTHS}; built and eager "
+        f"references in {time.time() - t0:.1f} s: {'ok' if not fails else fails}"
+    )
+    # the check's own control: a step that writes nothing must flag every element it poisons
+    wd = st[4]
+    wd.poison()
+    n_bad = sum((g_ != r_).sum().item() for g_, r_ in zip(wd.bufs, wd.ref))
+    n_all = sum(b.numel() for b in wd.bufs)
+    log(f"check control (no launch after poison): {n_bad} of {n_all} elements flagged")
+    if n_bad == 0 or n_bad < sum(b.numel() for b in wd.bufs[:6]):
+        fails.append("check control")
+
+    def capture(order):
+        pool = torch.cuda.graph_pool_handle()
+        graphs = {}
+        for M in order:
+            for kind, dr in (("plain", -1), ("delay", M % tp)):
+                gr = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                with torch.cuda.graph(gr, pool=pool):
+                    chain(st[M], delay_rank=dr, delay_us=200)
+                graphs[M, kind] = gr
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return graphs
+
+    t0 = time.time()
+    graphs = capture(sorted(WIDTHS, reverse=True))
+    log(f"captured {len(graphs)} graphs in {time.time() - t0:.1f} s")
+    big = torch.ones(
+        16 << 20, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev
+    )  # 64 MB: another collective's traffic
+    mat = torch.randn(4096, 4096, device=dev, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    count = {
+        "graph": 0,
+        "graph_delay": 0,
+        "eager": 0,
+        "eager_delay": 0,
+        "pre_delay": 0,
+        "foreign": 0,
+    }
+    phases = []
+    # this rank's mismatches by phase, width, step mode, rank delay before, foreign work before, kind, layer
+    det = torch.zeros(
+        PHASES,
+        len(WIDTHS),
+        len(MODES),
+        2,
+        2,
+        len(kinds),
+        L,
+        dtype=torch.int64,
+        device=dev,
+    )
+
+    def step(M, j, rng):
+        wd = st[M]
+        wd.poison()
+        if j % 11 == 10:
+            dist.all_reduce(big)  # RCCL on the same ranks between mono steps
+            big.mul_(1.0 / tp)
+            torch.mm(mat, mat)

+        if j % 5 == 4:

+            count["pre_delay"] += 1
+        if j % 7 == 6:
+            if rng.random() < 0.5:
+                chain(wd)
+                mode = "eager"
+            else:

+                mode = "eager_delay"
+        elif j % 3 == 2:

+            mode = "graph_delay"
+        else:
+            graphs[M, "plain"].replay()
+            mode = "graph"
+        count[mode] += 1
+        d = det[
+            len(phases) - 1,
+            WIDTHS.index(M),
+            MODES.index(mode),
+            int(j % 5 == 4),
+            int(j % 11 == 10),
+        ]
+        for k, (got, ref) in enumerate(zip(wd.bufs, wd.ref)):
+            bad = got != ref

+                d[k] += bad.flatten(1).sum(1)
+            else:
+                d[k, 0] += bad.sum()

+            f"phase {name}: {len(seq)} steps in {time.time() - t:.1f} s, mismatching elements {det.sum().item() - before}"

+    rng = random.Random(args.seed)  # the same sequence on every rank
+    W = list(WIDTHS)

+            args.state["fault_ref"] = stream_generate(args.port, FAULT_PROMPT, 512)
+        g = gates(args, srv, tag, decode)
+        cross_ok, cross_note = crossing(srv) if decode else (True, "")
+        text = srv.text()
+        plans = re.findall(r"(\w+) plan \w+: (\d+) layers, spans (\{[^}]*\})", text)
+        captured = len(re.findall(r"captured \w+ \d+ rows on monokernels", text))
+        ok = (
+            bool(plans)
+            and captured > 0
+            and "Paris" in answer
+            and g["gsm8k"] is not None
+            and (decode or g["niah"] == 1.0 or not args.niah)
+            and (g.get("logprobs") is not None or not args.kl)
+            and cross_ok
+            and srv.p.poll() is None
+        )
+        return (
+            ok,
+            f"ready {ready:.0f} s; plans {plans}; captured {captured}; answer {answer!r}; {shown(g)}; {cross_note}",
+            time.time() - t0,
+        )
+    finally:
+        srv.stop()
+
+
+def step_ab(args, decode=False):
+    on_tag, off_tag = ("on_decode", "off_decode") if decode else ("on", "off")
+    srv = Server(args, mono=False, decode=decode)
+    t0 = time.time()
+    try:
+        if not srv.wait_ready(args.load_timeout):
+            return False, "server did not start", time.time() - t0
+        off = gates(args, srv, off_tag, decode)
+        on = args.state.get(on_tag) or {}
+        acc_on, acc_off = on.get("gsm8k"), off["gsm8k"]
+        ok = (
+            acc_on is not None
+            and acc_off is not None
+            and abs(acc_on - acc_off) * 100 <= args.gsm8k_gap
+        )
+        note = f"GSM8K on {acc_on} off {acc_off} (gap limit {args.gsm8k_gap} points)"
+        if args.niah and not decode:
+            ok &= on.get("niah") == 1.0 and off["niah"] == 1.0
+            note += f"; NIAH on {on.get('niah')} {on.get('niah_notes')} off {off['niah']} {off['niah_notes']}"
+        if args.kl:
+            if (
+                on.get("logprobs")
+                and off.get("logprobs")
+                and off.get("logprobs_chunked")
+            ):
+                kl_ok, kl_note = kl_gate(
+                    on["logprobs"], off["logprobs"], off["logprobs_chunked"]
+                )
+                ok &= kl_ok
+                note += f"; {kl_note}"
+            else:
+                ok = False
+                note += f"; KL missing: on {shown(on)} off {shown(off)}"
+        if not decode:
+            (a_on, n_on), (a_off, n_off) = on.get("accept", (None, 0)), off["accept"]
+            drop = None if not (a_on and a_off) else 100 * (a_off - a_on) / a_off
+            ok &= drop is not None and drop <= 3.0
+            note += (
+                f"; DSpark accept length at {IN_FLIGHT} requests: on {a_on} ({n_on} log lines), off {a_off} "
+                f"({n_off}); drop {drop if drop is None else round(drop, 2)} % (limit 3 %)"
+            )
+        return ok, note, time.time() - t0
+    finally:
+        srv.stop()
+
+
+def stream(port, prompt, n, timeout=900):
+    """Stream a completion: (text chunks received, time of the last one, finished, client error)."""
+    body = json.dumps(
+        {"prompt": prompt, "max_tokens": n, "temperature": 0, "stream": True}
+    ).encode()
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1/completions",
+        body,
+        {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+    )
+    chunks, last, finished, err = 0, time.time(), False, None
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
+            for line in r:
+                line = line.strip()
+                if not line.startswith(b"data:"):
+                    continue
+                data = line[5:].strip()
+                if data == b"[DONE]":
+                    finished = True
+                    break
+                choice = json.loads(data)["choices"][0]
+                if choice.get("text"):
+                    chunks, last = chunks + 1, time.time()
+                finished |= bool(choice.get("finish_reason"))
+    except Exception as e:
+        err = type(e).__name__
+    return chunks, last, finished, err
+
+
+FAULT_PROMPT = "Count from 1 to 400, one number a line:"
+
+
+def stream_generate(port, text, n, timeout=900):
+    """Stream /generate greedily: (the token ids received, time of the last, finished, client error)."""
+    body = json.dumps(
+        {
+            "text": text,
+            "sampling_params": {
+                "temperature": 0.0,
+                "max_new_tokens": n,
+                "ignore_eos": True,
+            },
+            "stream": True,
+        }
+    ).encode()
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/generate", body, {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
+    )
+    ids, last, finished, err = [], time.time(), False, None
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
+            for line in r:
+                line = line.strip()
+                if not line.startswith(b"data:"):
+                    continue
+                data = line[5:].strip()
+                if data == b"[DONE]":
+                    break
+                obj = json.loads(data)
+                got = list(obj.get("output_ids") or [])
+                if got:
+                    # cumulative or incremental chunks
+                    ids = got if got[: len(ids)] == ids else ids + got
+                    last = time.time()
+                finished |= obj.get("meta_info", {}).get("finish_reason") is not None
+    except Exception as e:
+        err = type(e).__name__
+    return ids, last, finished, err
+
+
+def step_fault(args):
+    # stall rank 1's 'pmix' wait (mid-step: no rank can finish that step) well after capture, during a streamed
+    # request: every rank must stop within the deadline plus a margin and the request must not finish
+    srv = Server(
+        args,
+        mono=True,
+        env={"SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT": f"1:pmix:{args.fault_after}"},
+    )
+    t0 = time.time()
+    try:
+        if not srv.wait_ready(args.load_timeout):
+            return False, "server did not start", time.time() - t0
+        chunks, last, finished, err = stream(args.port, FAULT_PROMPT, 2048)
+        try:
+            srv.p.wait(timeout=300)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            pass
+        stopped = srv.p.poll() is not None
+        gone = time.time() - last
+        ok = stopped and not finished and chunks > 0 and gone <= DEADLINE_S + 90 + 300
+        return (
+            ok,
+            f"server stopped {stopped}; {chunks} chunks streamed, then nothing; last chunk to server exit "
+            f"{gone:.0f} s (deadline {DEADLINE_S} s); request finished {finished}; client {err}",
+            time.time() - t0,
+        )
+    finally:
+        srv.stop()
+
+
+def step_fault_last(args):
+    # decode steps, one request: every forward on monokernels runs the ffn span on all 40 layers, so the FFN
+    # launch 40 m + 39 is the last layer of a forward whatever the warm-up count. Rank 1 stalls at that launch's
+    # epoch wait, after its last send: its peers finish the launch, but the step's logits gather needs rank 1, so
+    # no token of the step can be sent (RFC section 8)
+    ref = args.state.get("fault_ref")
+    after = 40 * args.fault_forwards + 39
+    srv = Server(
+        args,
+        mono=True,
+        env={"SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT": f"1:epoch:{after}"},
+        decode=True,
+    )
+    t0 = time.time()
+    try:
+        if not srv.wait_ready(args.load_timeout):
+            return False, "server did not start", time.time() - t0
+        ids, last, finished, err = stream_generate(args.port, FAULT_PROMPT, 512)
+        try:
+            srv.p.wait(timeout=300)
+        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+            pass
+        stopped = srv.p.poll() is not None
+        gone = time.time() - last
+        ref_ids = ref[0] if ref else None
+        matches = ref_ids is not None and ids == ref_ids[: len(ids)]
+        ok = (
+            stopped
+            and not finished
+            and 0 < len(ids) < 512
+            and matches
+            and gone <= DEADLINE_S + 90 + 300
+        )
+        return (
+            ok,
+            f"stall at FFN launch {after} (last layer of a forward); server stopped {stopped}; {len(ids)} tokens "
+            f"sent, all equal to the answer without the fault: {matches}; last token to server exit {gone:.0f} s; "
+            f"request finished {finished}; client {err}",
+            time.time() - t0,
+        )
+    finally:
+        srv.stop()
+
+
+STEPS = {
+    "cpu": step_cpu,
+    "kernels": step_kernels,
+    "guard": step_guard,
+    "refuse": step_refuse,
+    "serve": step_serve,
+    "ab": step_ab,
+    "serve_decode": lambda a: step_serve(a, decode=True),
+    "ab_decode": lambda a: step_ab(a, decode=True),
+    "fault": step_fault,
+    "fault_last": step_fault_last,
+}
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--model", default="deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash")
+    ap.add_argument("--tp", type=int, default=4)
+    ap.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=31170)
+    ap.add_argument("--steps", default=",".join(STEPS))
+    ap.add_argument("--gsm8k", type=int, default=1319)
+    ap.add_argument("--gsm8k-gap", type=float, default=1.0)
+    ap.add_argument("--niah", type=int, default=1)
+    ap.add_argument("--kl", type=int, default=1)
+    ap.add_argument("--host-table", type=int, default=1)
+    ap.add_argument("--fault-after", type=int, default=4000)
+    # forwards on monokernels before the last-layer stall: past the capture warm-ups and the server's warm-up
+    ap.add_argument("--fault-forwards", type=int, default=150)
+    ap.add_argument("--load-timeout", type=int, default=3600)
+    ap.add_argument("--out", default="validate_out")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    os.makedirs(args.out, exist_ok=True)
+    args.state = {}
+    results = []
+    for name in args.steps.split(","):
+        try:
+            ok, note, secs = STEPS[name](args)
+        except Exception as e:
+            ok, note, secs = False, f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", 0.0
+        results.append((name, ok, note, secs))
+        print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} ({secs:.0f} s): {note}", flush=True)
+    print(
+        f"{sum(ok for _, ok, _, _ in results)} of {len(results)} steps passed",
+        flush=True,
+    )
+    sys.exit(0 if all(ok for _, ok, _, _ in results) else 1)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""Serving tests of DeepSeek-V4.1's monokernels (gfx950, TP4, DSpark): steps that cross the largest width and come

+PORT = int(os.environ.get("MONO_PORT", "31170"))

+    f"--model-path {MODEL} --tp 4 --port {PORT} --trust-remote-code --ep-size 1 --mem-fraction-static 0.70 "
+    "--chunked-prefill-size 16384 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-dspark-block-size 5 "
+    "--max-running-requests 16 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 64 --watchdog-timeout 3600 "

+    "--enforce-shared-experts-fusion --enable-monokernel"
+)
+
+
+class Server:
+    def __init__(self, log_name, env=None):
+        self.log = open(log_name, "w")
+        self.p = subprocess.Popen(
+            f"{sys.executable} -m sglang.launch_server {ARGS}", shell=True, env={**os.environ, **(env or {})},
+            stdout=self.log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+
+    def ready(self, timeout=3600):
+        t0 = time.time()
+        while time.time() - t0 < timeout and self.p.poll() is None:
+            try:
+                urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/health", timeout=5)
+                return True
+            except Exception:
+                time.sleep(10)
+        return False
+
+    def text(self):
+        self.log.flush()
+        return open(self.log.name, errors="replace").read()
+
+    def stop(self):
+        if self.p.poll() is None:
+            os.killpg(self.p.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
+            try:
+                self.p.wait(timeout=120)
+            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
+                os.killpg(self.p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
+
+
+def complete(prompt, n=64, timeout=900):
+    body = json.dumps({"prompt": prompt, "max_tokens": n, "temperature": 0}).encode()
+    req = urllib.request.Request(
+        f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/v1/completions",
+        body,
+        {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+    )
+    out = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout))
+    return out["choices"][0]["text"], out["choices"][0].get("finish_reason")
+
+
+PROMPTS = [f"Question {i}: what is {i} times {i + 3}? Answer:" for i in range(16)]
+
+
+class TestSwitchPoints(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_cross_the_largest_width_and_back(self):
+        srv = Server("e2e_switch_points.log")
+        try:
+            self.assertTrue(srv.ready(), "server did not start")
+            phases = {}
+            for name, conc in (
+                ("1", 1),
+                ("8 (48 rows)", 8),
+                ("12 (72 rows)", 12),
+                ("1 again", 1),
+            ):
+                with cf.ThreadPoolExecutor(conc) as ex:
+                    phases[name] = list(ex.map(complete, PROMPTS[:conc]))
+                for text, finish in phases[name]:
+                    self.assertTrue(text.strip(), f"empty answer in phase {name}")
+                    self.assertIn(finish, ("stop", "length"))
+            log = srv.text()
+            self.assertRegex(log, r"captured target_verify 48 rows on monokernels")
+            self.assertRegex(
+                log, r"target_verify steps of (5[4-9]|[6-9]\d) rows take the model path"
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                phases["1"][0][0],
+                phases["1 again"][0][0],
+                "the same request differs after the switch",
+            )
+        finally:
+            srv.stop()
+
+
+class TestFault(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_stalled_wait_stops_every_rank(self):
+        # 'pmix' is a mid-step wait: with rank 1 stalled there, no rank can finish that step
+        after = int(os.environ.get("MONO_FAULT_AFTER", "4000"))
+        srv = Server(
+            "e2e_fault.log", env={"SGLANG_TEST_MONO_FAULT_INJECT": f"1:pmix:{after}"}
+        )
+        try:
+            self.assertTrue(srv.ready(), "server did not start")
+            answer = None
+            t0 = time.time()
+            try:
+                answer = complete("Count from 1 to 400, one number a line:", n=2048)
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            srv.p.wait(timeout=300)
+            self.assertIsNone(answer, "the stalled step's request got an answer")
+            self.assertIsNotNone(srv.p.poll(), "the server is still running")
+            log = srv.text()
+            self.assertTrue(
+                re.search(r"Memory access fault|HIP error|died|exited", log),
+                "no stop in the log",
+            )
+            print(
+                f"server stopped {time.time() - t0:.0f} s after the request", flush=True
+            )
+        finally:
+            srv.stop()
+

+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Check DeepSeek-V4.1's ffn span against SGLang's ops on gfx950 at every production width, TP2 and TP4: the
+spec's numerics (max_abs / max_rel per output), graph replay of every width back to back, no allocation across a
+capture and its replays, and a digest of every output for the old-against-new comparison.
+
+Run directly: ``python3 test_dsv41_ffn.py`` relaunches itself under torchrun with 2 and 4 GPUs."""
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import types
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+from sglang.test.kernels.utils import multigpu_pytest_main
+
+register_amd_ci(est_time=900, suite="nightly-amd-8-gpu-mi35x", nightly=True)
+
+HIDDEN, HC, MIX = 5120, 4, 24
+E, TOPK, SCALE, LIMIT = 384, 6, 1.5, 10.0
+INTER, PAD = 2304, 128
+RMS_EPS, HC_EPS = 1e-20, 1e-6
+MAX_ROWS = 48
+REPLAYS = 500
+# widths no capture reaches, kept to cover the kernels' odd shapes
+EXTRA_WIDTHS = (3, 5, 7, 17, 31, 33, 47)
+
+
+def production_widths(extra=EXTRA_WIDTHS):
+    """The widths attach builds (runtime.widths_for) for the cookbook's decode graphs (--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode
+    64, SGLang's capture sizes) without and with DSpark (6 tokens a verify step), plus ``extra``."""
+    from sglang.experimental.monokernels.runtime import widths_for
+    from sglang.srt.arg_groups.cuda_graph_hook import (
+        generate_decode_cuda_graph_batch_sizes,
+    )
+
+    out = set(extra)
+    for algorithm, tokens in ((None, None), ("DSPARK", 6)):
+        cfg = types.SimpleNamespace(
+            disable_cuda_graph_padding=False, speculative_algorithm=algorithm
+        )
+        sizes = generate_decode_cuda_graph_batch_sizes(cfg, 64)
+        for widths in widths_for(sizes, tokens, MAX_ROWS).values():
+            out.update(widths)
+    return sorted(out)
+
+
+def init_dist():
+    """This torchrun rank's (rank, TP size, device, CPU group); the process group once per process."""
+    rank, tp = int(os.environ["RANK"]), int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(int(os.environ.get("LOCAL_RANK", rank)))
+    if not dist.is_initialized():
+        dist.init_process_group("nccl")
+    return rank, tp, torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+
+
+FP4 = [
+    0.0,
+    0.5,
+    1.0,
+    1.5,
+    2.0,
+    3.0,
+    4.0,
+    6.0,
+    -0.0,
+    -0.5,
+    -1.0,
+    -1.5,
+    -2.0,
+    -3.0,
+    -4.0,
+    -6.0,
+]
+
+
+def cos(a, b):
+    return F.cosine_similarity(
+        a.float().reshape(-1), b.float().reshape(-1), dim=0
+    ).item()
+
+
+def rel(a, b):
+    a, b = a.float().reshape(-1), b.float().reshape(-1)
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+
+
+def bf16_ulps(a, b):
+    """(max difference in bf16 ulps, share of elements that differ) of two bf16 tensors."""
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    _, e = torch.frexp(torch.maximum(a.abs(), b.abs()))
+    ulps = (a - b).abs() / torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(a), e - 8)
+    return ulps.max().item(), (a != b).float().mean().item()
+
+
+def hc_post_fp64(a, res, post, comb):
+    """fp64 hc_post of the reduced bf16 attention output ``a``: (each element, its largest term's |.|)."""
+    terms = torch.cat(
+        [
+            (post.double()[:, :, None] * a.double()[:, None, :])[..., None],
+            (comb.double()[..., None] * res.double()[:, :, None, :]).permute(
+                0, 2, 3, 1
+            ),
+        ],
+        -1,
+    )
+    return terms.sum(-1), terms.abs().amax(-1)  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def term_ulps(out, ref, big):
+    """Max |out - ref| in bf16 ulps of ``big``: a near-cancelling sum has no meaningful ulp of its own."""
+    _, e = torch.frexp(big)
+    return (
+        ((out.double() - ref).abs() / torch.ldexp(torch.ones_like(big), e - 8))
+        .max()
+        .item()
+    )
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- MX helpers (the launch's rules)
+def code_ceil(v):
+    """Biased exponent of the smallest power of two >= v (v > 0), clamped to [lo, 254]."""
+    bits = v.float().contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+    return ((bits >> 23) & 0xFF) + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).int()
+
+
+def mxfp8_qdq(x, rule):
+    """Per-32 MXFP8 quantize-dequantize: "aiter" (routed experts) or "vllm" (shared expert) scale rule."""
+    g = x.float().reshape(*x.shape[:-1], -1, 32)
+    amax = g.abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True)
+    if rule == "aiter":
+        code = code_ceil(amax.clamp_min(1e-10) * (1.0 / 448)).clamp(1, 254)
+    else:
+        code = code_ceil(amax.clamp_min(torch.finfo(torch.float32).tiny) / 448.0).clamp(
+            0, 254
+        )
+    inv = torch.exp2(127.0 - code.float())
+    q = (g * inv).clamp(-448, 448).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()
+    return (q / inv).reshape(x.shape)
+
+
+def deq_fp4(packed, scale):
+    """[N, K / 2] packed e2m1 (even index low nibble), [N, K / 32] E8M0 -> [N, K] f32."""
+    lut = torch.tensor(FP4, device=packed.device)
+    p = packed.view(torch.uint8).long()
+    v = torch.stack([lut[p & 15], lut[p >> 4]], -1).flatten(-2)
+    return v * torch.exp2(scale.view(torch.uint8).float() - 127).repeat_interleave(
+        32, -1
+    )
+
+
+def deq_fp8_block(w, scale):
+    """[N, K] e4m3 with [N / 32, K / 32] E8M0 blocks -> f32."""
+    s = torch.exp2(scale.view(torch.uint8).float() - 127)
+    return w.float() * s.repeat_interleave(32, 0).repeat_interleave(32, 1)
+
+
+def bf(x):
+    return x.to(torch.bfloat16).float()
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- weights
+def make_weights(tp, rank, dev, seed=0):
+    """One layer's tensors on this rank in SGLang's loaded layout, plus the copies the golden model reads."""

+        type("B", (), {"__cuda_array_interface__": {"shape": (64 * tp,), "typestr": "|u1", "data": (buf, False), "version": 3}})(),
+        device="cuda:0",
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    view.zero_()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    handle = UncachedIpcHeap.get_mem_handle_bytes(buf)
+    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
+    out = ctx.Queue()
+    port = _port()
+    procs = [
+        ctx.Process(
+            target=rank_main, args=(r, tp, port, site, after, kind, mode, handle, out)
+        )
+        for r in range(tp)
+    ]
+    for p in procs:
+        p.start()
+    table, done, stall_at, stalled_gone = {}, {}, None, None
+    deadline = time.time() + 900
+    stalled_step = WARM + after
+    tree_killed = []
+    while any(p.is_alive() for p in procs) and time.time() < deadline:
+        if (
+            stall_at is None and any(p.exitcode not in (None, 0) for p in procs)
+        ):  # a rank died before the stalled step: setup failed (a port taken, for example)
+            break
+        if procs[STALLED_RANK].exitcode is not None and stalled_gone is None:
+            stalled_gone = time.time()
+        if (
+            mode == "step"
+            and stalled_gone is not None
+            and time.time() - stalled_gone > TREE_KILL_S
+        ):
+            tree_killed = [r for r, p in enumerate(procs) if p.is_alive()]
+            break
+        try:
+            msg = out.get(timeout=2)
+        except queue.Empty:
+            continue
+        if msg[0] == "sites":
+            table[msg[1]] = (msg[2], msg[3])
+        elif msg[0] == "start" and msg[1] == STALLED_RANK and msg[2] == stalled_step:
+            stall_at = msg[3]
+        elif msg[0] == "done":
+            done.setdefault(msg[1], []).append(msg[2])
+    setup_failed = stall_at is None
+    alive = [r for r, p in enumerate(procs) if p.is_alive() and r not in tree_killed]
+    for p in procs:
+        if p.is_alive():
+            p.kill()
+        p.join(timeout=30)
+    t_end = time.time() if not tree_killed else stalled_gone
+    words = view.view(torch.int32).view(tp, 16)[:, :3].tolist()
+    UncachedIpcHeap.free_device_mem(buf)
+    same_sites = all(
+        list(s) == list(g.sites()) and list(w) == list(s) for s, w in table.values()
+    )
+    reasons = {
+        r: g.decode_reason(w[g.MIRROR_DEADLINE] or w[g.MIRROR_PEER])
+        for r, w in enumerate(words)
+    }
+    armed = g.site_name(words[STALLED_RANK][g.MIRROR_ARMED])
+    completed = sorted(r for r, steps in done.items() if stalled_step in steps)
+    stop_s = (t_end - stall_at) if stall_at else None
+    known = set(g.sites())
+    peers_may_finish = mode == "launch" and site in LAST_EXCHANGE
+    ok = (
+        not alive
+        and same_sites
+        and stall_at is not None
+        and stop_s <= DEADLINE_S + MARGIN_S
+        and armed == site
+        and reasons[STALLED_RANK].get("reason") == "deadline"
+        and all(
+            reasons[r].get("reason") in ("deadline", "peer stopped")
+            and reasons[r].get("site") in known
+            for r in range(tp)
+            if r not in tree_killed
+        )
+        and STALLED_RANK not in completed
+        and (not completed or peers_may_finish)
+    )
+    return setup_failed, ok, {
+        "tp": tp, "site": site, "after": after, "kind": kind, "mode": mode,
+        "stop_s": round(stop_s, 1) if stop_s else None, "armed": armed, "alive_at_timeout": alive,
+        "stopped_by_tree_kill": tree_killed, "reasons": reasons, "completed_stalled_step": completed,
+        "same_site_ids": same_sites, "exitcodes": [p.exitcode for p in procs],
+    }  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def run_case(tp, site, after, kind, mode):
+    """One case; once more on a fresh port when a rank died before the stalled step."""
+    for attempt in (1, 2):
+        setup_failed, ok, info = _attempt(tp, site, after, kind, mode)
+        info["attempt"] = attempt
+        if not setup_failed:
+            break
+    return ok, info
+
+
+def main():
+    from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41.gfx950.layer import (
+        WAIT_SITES,
+    )
+
+    _no_core()  # the parent spawns the ranks; make it non-dumpable too
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--tp", type=int, default=4)
+    ap.add_argument("--sites", default=",".join(WAIT_SITES))
+    ap.add_argument("--after", default="0,3")
+    ap.add_argument("--mode", default="launch", choices=("launch", "step"))
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    fails = 0
+    for site in args.sites.split(","):
+        if site not in WAIT_SITES:
+            raise SystemExit(f"unknown wait site {site!r}; sites: {WAIT_SITES}")
+        for after in (int(a) for a in args.after.split(",")):
+            kind = "k1" if site in K1_SITES else "ffn"
+            ok, info = run_case(args.tp, site, after, kind, args.mode)
+            fails += not ok
+            print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + json.dumps(info), flush=True)
+    print("ALL PASS" if not fails else f"FAILED {fails}", flush=True)
+    sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""The monokernels import from aiter only what the stock aiter of the tested image defines (e7d2453f, the manifest
+aiter_e7d2453f.json next to this file, generated from its sources): every ``from aiter... import name``, every
+attribute read off an imported aiter module (``bo.buffer_load``) and every attribute of an imported aiter class
+(``UncachedIpcHeap.alloc_uncached``). Reads sources only, so it runs without aiter and never skips."""
+
+import ast
+import json
+import pathlib
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+PLUGIN = (
+    pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
+    / "python/sglang/experimental/monokernels"
+)
+MANIFEST = json.loads(
+    (pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name("aiter_e7d2453f.json")).read_text()
+)
+
+
+def needs():
+    """(file, aiter module, name or Class.attr) for every aiter name the plugin uses."""
+    modules = MANIFEST["modules"]
+    out = []
+    for path in sorted(PLUGIN.rglob("*.py")):
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        mods, classes = {}, {}
+        for node in ast.walk(tree):
+            if (
+                isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom)
+                and (node.module or "").split(".")[0] == "aiter"
+            ):
+                for a in node.names:
+                    full = f"{node.module}.{a.name}"
+                    if full in modules:
+                        mods[a.asname or a.name] = full
+                    else:
+                        out.append((path.name, node.module, a.name))
+                        classes[a.asname or a.name] = (node.module, a.name)
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                for a in node.names:
+                    if a.name.split(".")[0] == "aiter":
+                        out.append((path.name, a.name, ""))
+        for node in ast.walk(tree):
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Name):
+                if node.value.id in mods:
+                    out.append((path.name, mods[node.value.id], node.attr))
+                elif node.value.id in classes:
+                    mod, cls = classes[node.value.id]
+                    out.append((path.name, mod, f"{cls}.{node.attr}"))
+    return sorted(set(out))
+
+
+class TestAiterImports(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_manifest_is_the_stock_aiter(self):
+        self.assertTrue(MANIFEST["aiter"].startswith("e7d2453f"))
+
+    def test_every_name_is_in_the_manifest(self):
+        missing, checked = [], 0
+        for fname, module, name in needs():
+            checked += 1
+            entry = MANIFEST["modules"].get(module)
+            if entry is None:
+                missing.append(f"{fname}: module {module} is not in the manifest")
+                continue
+            cls, _, attr = name.partition(".")
+            ok = (not name or cls in entry["names"]) and (
+                not attr or attr in entry["classes"].get(cls, [])
+            )
+            if not ok:
+                missing.append(f"{fname}: {module}.{name}")
+        self.assertGreater(checked, 20)
+        self.assertEqual(missing, [])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""CPU tests of the DeepSeek-V4.1 spec: the spans of every layer per step type on the checkpoint's layout, the
+refusal reasons for the cookbook recipe and its variants, and where the model calls the weight hooks."""
+
+import ast
+import pathlib
+import types
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+import sglang
+from sglang.experimental.monokernels.hip.deepseek_v41 import spec as dsv41

+
